jobs.title: Project Manager – Marketing Division
jobs.description:
**Project Manager – Marketing Division**

**Position Summary** We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the planning, coordination, and delivery of marketing initiatives, campaigns, projects, and related workstreams for a California public-sector healthcare organization. This position will coordinate activities among internal staff, business partners, subject-matter experts, technical teams, leadership, and external vendors. The Project Manager will maintain project schedules and management artifacts, facilitate stakeholder meetings, monitor deliverables, and provide regular updates to leadership.

**What You’ll Do** ✔ Plan, coordinate, and track marketing projects, campaigns, and related workstreams.✔ Coordinate activities across business teams, subject-matter experts, technical teams, leadership, and external vendors.✔ Develop and maintain project schedules, work plans, action-item trackers, status reports, meeting notes, and risk and issue logs.✔ Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, priorities, and resource requirements.✔ Identify and help resolve project risks, issues, blockers, and escalations.✔ Facilitate planning sessions, status meetings, stakeholder discussions, and vendor-coordination meetings.✔ Support work intake, prioritization, assignment, sequencing, and delivery planning.✔ Track vendor activities and deliverables to ensure alignment with project objectives and timelines.✔ Provide leadership with regular updates on accomplishments, upcoming activities, risks, issues, required decisions, and recommended next steps.✔ Apply Agile, hybrid, or traditional project-management methods based on the needs of each assignment.

**What We’re Looking For**✔ Strong project-management experience involving multiple business and technical stakeholders.✔ Experience managing project schedules, work plans, risks, issues, action items, dependencies, and deliverables.✔ Strong stakeholder, vendor, and cross-functional team coordination experience.✔ Excellent executive communication, reporting, facilitation, and presentation skills.✔ Experience using project and work-management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Smartsheet, SharePoint, or similar platforms.✔ Experience supporting marketing, communications, campaigns, or digital initiatives is preferred.✔ California state government, public-sector, healthcare, health insurance, or health-benefit exchange experience is preferred.✔ Ability to work on-site at the client’s Sacramento office.✔ Ability to successfully complete the client’s required background-clearance process.

**Why This Role Stands Out**✔ High-visibility work supporting important statewide healthcare initiatives.✔ Opportunity to coordinate complex marketing programs involving multiple stakeholders and vendors.✔ Direct interaction with business teams, technical teams, and client leadership.✔ Potential long-term engagement, subject to project needs, funding, performance, and contract continuation.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing & Growth
jobs.description:
**Director of Marketing & Growth**

Remote | Up to 35% travel | Full-time | Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

**About the Role**

The Director of Marketing & Growth leads marketing strategy for Independence Dental Services and its partner practices, with one clear goal: profitable new-patient growth. This is a hands-on leader who ties every dollar of spend to patients, collections, and gross margin, and who uses AI and modern marketing technology to work faster and smarter. You will partner closely with executives, partner dentists, and operations leaders.

**What You'll Do**

***Strategy & Budget***

* Build and execute corporate and practice-level marketing strategies, campaigns, and growth plans.
* Own the annual and monthly marketing budget; shift spend based on practice needs and return.
* Use market research and competitive data to identify target audiences and new-patient opportunities.

***Performance & ROI***

* Own marketing reporting: acquisition cost, lead conversion, appointments, collections, ROI, and gross-margin impact.
* Partner with Finance and Operations to validate results and turn findings into specific actions.

***Digital Channels***

* Manage practice websites, SEO, paid search, Google Business Profiles, and social media to generate and convert new patients.
* Hold agencies and vendors accountable for deliverables, spend, and results.

***Practice Partnership***

* Coach practices on marketing effectiveness and work with operations leaders to remove barriers such as call handling, scheduling, capacity, and patient follow-up.
* Present recommendations to leadership and train corporate and practice teams.
* Support trade shows, industry events, and corporate events.

***AI & Innovation***

* Test and adopt AI, automation, and emerging marketing tools that improve analysis, content, and campaign performance, and measure their business value.

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years of marketing experience, with a track record of profitable growth you can back up with data.
* Strong command of marketing economics: ROI, acquisition cost, and gross margin.
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, SEO, analytics platforms, and Google Workspace.
* Practical experience using AI tools to improve marketing efficiency and decision-making.
* Clear communicator who can influence dentists, executives, and vendors without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Dental, healthcare, or multi-location services experience preferred.

**Work Environment**

Remote, with regular travel to practices and events (up to 35%). Requires extended periods of computer work.

jobs.title: Marketing & Community Outreach Specialist
jobs.description:
Marketing & Community Outreach Specialist

**Home Care Harbor | Idaho Falls, Idaho**  
**Compensation:** $30,000–$40,000 per year plus commissions. Paid interns and externs: $20,000 per year plus commissions.  
**Schedule:** Full-time, at least 40 hours per week. Availability for 45–50 hours per week is encouraged depending on the time of year and marketing strategies being executed.  
**Reports directly to:** Chief Executive Officer

Build a marketing career with a mission worth believing in.

Some of the people who helped advance America’s energy and national defense did so at a lasting cost to their health. At Home Care Harbor, we believe their contribution deserves recognition—and exceptional care.

Your work will help these individuals and their families discover the services available to them, understand their options, and connect with a team committed to serving them with dignity.

We are seeking an articulate, creative, and motivated marketing professional who wants meaningful responsibility, direct executive mentorship, and room to grow. Bring your marketing foundation, initiative, and commitment to our mission. We will provide substantial training, a meaningful marketing budget, and time to learn the work thoroughly.

Work directly with a CEO invested in your development.

You will report directly to our CEO, a former vice president of a multibillion-dollar company. This position is designed to combine real ownership with hands-on guidance.

You will work together on strategy, campaign decisions, community relationships, and professional presentations. When appropriate, the CEO will join you at events, co-host engagements, and travel with you to support important opportunities.

You will have access to an experienced executive who will help you develop your judgment, strengthen your communication, and understand how marketing contributes to a growing healthcare organization.

What you will do

* **Turn strategy into action.** Help develop and execute a marketing plan that builds awareness, earns trust, and connects appropriate audiences with our services.
* **Strengthen our digital presence.** Create and coordinate website content, social media, email campaigns, digital advertising, and search visibility.
* **Build community relationships.** Develop professional connections with healthcare providers, community organizations, and groups connected to the people we serve.
* **Represent our mission in person.** Deliver clear, engaging presentations and participate in community meetings, conferences, educational programs, and outreach events.
* **Coordinate local media.** Identify opportunities involving television, radio, news outlets, print publications, and other effective channels.
* **Plan events that matter.** Organize logistics, materials, scheduling, presentations, and follow-up for events and speaking engagements.
* **Manage resources thoughtfully.** Help oversee marketing spending, coordinate vendors, track campaign performance, and recommend improvements.
* **Protect the trust we earn.** Communicate accurately, respect patient privacy, and represent Home Care Harbor professionally in every setting.
* **Keep learning.** Develop a strong understanding of our services, the populations we serve, and the requirements that guide our work.

Who will thrive here

You communicate with clarity, listen carefully, and follow through. You can speak confidently with a family, a community leader, or an executive while treating each person with equal respect.

You are comfortable contributing ideas, receiving feedback, and taking responsibility for the details that make a campaign or event successful.

We are looking for:

* A working foundation in marketing strategy, digital marketing, social media, content creation, and campaign measurement.
* Strong writing, speaking, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Organization, sound judgment, initiative, and dependable follow-through.
* Comfort learning marketing platforms, contact-management tools, and reporting systems.
* The ability to manage several priorities while maintaining professional standards.
* Respect for the people whose work supported America’s energy and defense capabilities—and a sincere commitment to helping them access excellent care.
* Willingness and ability to travel within the assigned region.

A degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field is encouraged, but **not required**. Relevant experience, a strong portfolio, initiative, and demonstrated ability also matter.

Healthcare experience is welcome, but it is not required. We provide substantial training in our services, our mission, and the responsibilities of representing Home Care Harbor.

Early-career candidates are welcome.

Recent graduates and candidates seeking their first career opportunity are encouraged to apply. We also welcome applicants interested in a **paid internship or externship at $20,000 per year plus commissions**.

Eligible interns, externs, and recent graduates entering their first career role may qualify for tuition reimbursement under our program terms.

If you are graduating soon, you may interview now and be considered for an offer with a start date aligned with graduation.

Support, benefits, and room to grow

* Direct CEO mentorship and regular collaboration.
* Substantial onboarding and ongoing professional development.
* A meaningful marketing budget and opportunities to manage real initiatives.
* Health insurance, subject to the plan’s eligibility and enrollment terms.
* A 401(k) with employer matching for eligible participants.
* Tuition reimbursement for qualifying early-career participants.
* Paid work-related travel, with access to a company vehicle or mileage reimbursement, as applicable.
* Opportunities for increased responsibility, advancement, and compensation growth as your contributions and the company develop.
* Commissions, with potential additional financial incentives subject to role eligibility a

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a creative, strategic, and results-driven **Digital Marketing Manager** to lead and execute innovative digital marketing initiatives that strengthen brand awareness, expand audience reach, generate engagement, and drive sustainable organic growth.

The ideal candidate combines creativity with analytical thinking and has a strong understanding of digital media, content development, social media strategy, and performance-based marketing. This individual will be responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive marketing strategy that positions the company for continued growth through compelling content, innovative campaigns, audience development, and measurable business outcomes.

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond traditional marketing approaches, identifies new opportunities to reach and engage our target audience, and consistently turns ideas into effective marketing initiatives.

This is a hybrid remote position that offers flexibility while maintaining collaboration, accountability, and alignment with company objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Marketing & Brand Development

* Develop and execute a comprehensive digital marketing strategy aligned with company goals, brand identity, and growth objectives.
* Identify target audiences, market trends, competitive opportunities, and emerging digital marketing channels.
* Create integrated marketing campaigns that increase brand awareness, strengthen market positioning, and generate qualified leads or customer opportunities.
* Establish a consistent brand voice and visual identity across digital platforms and marketing materials.
* Develop short- and long-term marketing plans with clear objectives, timelines, budgets, and performance benchmarks.

2. Media Content Creation & Development

* Plan, create, and coordinate engaging digital media content, including graphics, videos, short-form video, photography, written content, and promotional materials.
* Develop compelling storytelling and creative concepts that communicate the company's value, services, products, and brand personality.
* Produce content tailored to the audience, platform, and purpose of each campaign.
* Maintain a strategic content calendar that supports consistent publishing and coordinated marketing initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to repurpose content across multiple channels to maximize reach, efficiency, and return on effort.
* Collaborate with internal team members, external partners, or creative vendors as needed to develop high-quality marketing assets.

3. Social Media Strategy & Audience Engagement

* Manage and grow the company's social media presence across relevant platforms, such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
* Develop platform-specific strategies that prioritize meaningful engagement, audience growth, brand visibility, and conversion opportunities.
* Monitor comments, messages, trends, conversations, and audience feedback to strengthen relationships and build community.
* Identify opportunities to leverage trending topics, relevant conversations, user-generated content, collaborations, and other creative approaches.
* Establish consistent posting schedules and evaluate content effectiveness to continuously improve results.
* Maintain a proactive approach to social media trends, platform updates, and emerging audience behaviors.

4. Innovative & Creative Marketing Initiatives

* Develop fresh, unconventional marketing ideas that differentiate the company from competitors.
* Research and test new platforms, tools, technologies, partnerships, and campaign concepts.
* Design creative campaigns that encourage audience participation, sharing, referrals, and repeat engagement.
* Explore opportunities for influencer collaborations, strategic partnerships, community outreach, and cross-promotional campaigns.
* Use experimentation and performance data to determine which creative approaches deliver the strongest results.
* Bring forward new ideas regularly and take ownership of moving promising concepts from planning to execution.

5. Organic Growth & Audience Development

* Develop and execute a measurable organic growth plan that expands the company's digital presence without relying exclusively on paid advertising.
* Improve search engine visibility through SEO strategy, keyword research, website content optimization, and relevant content development.
* Build a sustainable content strategy designed to attract, educate, engage, and retain the target audience.
* Increase organic social media reach, engagement, website traffic, and audience growth through consistent, high-value content.
* Identify opportunities to improve website discoverability, conversion pathways, and overall digital user experience.
* Encourage community building, referrals, partnerships, and audience advocacy.
* Establish a clear growth roadmap with monthly and quarterly milestones, performance benchmarks, and continuous improvement initiatives.

6. Performance Measurement & Analytics

Marketing Manager — Brand Growth & Franchise Marketing

The Protein Spot | Boise, Idaho | Full-Time

Help Build the Next Great Protein-Focused Food Brand

The Protein Spot is entering an exciting new chapter.

We’ve built a brand centered around convenient, high-quality, protein-focused food that supports active lifestyles. Now, we’re preparing to grow beyond our corporate locations and expand through franchising.

We’re looking for a creative, ambitious, hands-on Marketing Manager who wants to help build something from the ground up.

This isn’t a position where you’ll inherit a massive marketing department or spend your days sitting in meetings. You’ll have the opportunity to own our marketing strategy, execute campaigns, grow our brand presence, and help create the marketing systems that will support The Protein Spot as we scale.

We’re looking for someone who can think strategically on Monday and execute on Tuesday.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Strategy & Brand Growth

* Develop and manage quarterly and annual marketing plans aligned with company growth objectives.
* Build and execute promotional calendars, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.
* Maintain a consistent brand identity across all marketing channels.
* Identify opportunities to increase awareness, customer acquisition, purchase frequency, and retention.

Social Media & Content

* Own The Protein Spot’s social media strategy across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Plan, create, coordinate, and publish engaging content.
* Capture content in-store and collaborate with team members, customers, and local creators.
* Develop campaigns that build community and drive measurable store traffic.
* Track engagement, audience growth, and campaign performance.

Local Store Marketing

* Develop and execute marketing initiatives for our corporate locations.
* Build partnerships with gyms, fitness studios, businesses, schools, and community organizations.
* Coordinate local promotions, sampling opportunities, events, and brand activations.
* Work with store leadership to identify sales opportunities and execute localized campaigns.
* Build repeatable local marketing programs that can eventually be implemented across franchise locations.

Customer Loyalty & Digital Marketing

* Manage and optimize our Toast loyalty and rewards programs.
* Build targeted email and SMS campaigns that drive customer retention and repeat purchases.
* Maintain and improve website content, promotions, and landing pages.
* Understand and apply foundational SEO and local search best practices.
* Help manage Google Business Profiles and local online presence.
* Track campaign performance and continually improve results.

Franchise Marketing Systems

* Help develop a standardized marketing playbook for future franchisees.
* Create repeatable marketing calendars, campaign templates, and brand assets.
* Establish processes that allow local operators to execute effective marketing while maintaining brand consistency.
* Collaborate with leadership as we build our franchise support infrastructure.

What We’re Looking For

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in marketing, brand management, digital marketing, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and content creation.
* Experience with email marketing, customer loyalty programs, and digital marketing tools.
* Working knowledge of website management, basic SEO, and Google Business Profiles.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects independently.
* A creative mindset paired with a results-driven approach.
* Comfort working in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment.
* Willingness to get hands-on with content, local events, and in-store execution.

Bonus Points

* Experience in restaurant, hospitality, fitness, wellness, or consumer brands.
* Familiarity with Toast POS and loyalty marketing.
* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, or video editing tools.
* Experience managing Meta or Google advertising campaigns.
* Experience supporting multi-location businesses or franchise brands.
* A genuine interest in fitness, nutrition, and healthy living.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first six months, you’ll have:

* Established a consistent, measurable marketing calendar.
* Built an organized social media content and execution system.
* Improved our loyalty marketing and customer engagement.
* Developed and executed local marketing campaigns across our corporate locations.
* Created the foundation for a repeatable franchisee marketing playbook.

This is an opportunity to get involved at a pivotal stage of growth.

You’ll work directly with company leadership, have meaningful ownership over your work, and help shape how our brand shows up in the market.

As The Protein Spot expands, so will the marketing function and the opportunities for the person who helps build it.

Send your resume along with examples of marketing campaigns, social content, or brands you’ve helped grow.

We’d especially love to hear about a campaign you personally developed and executed, what you did, and the results it produced.

We’re looking for a builder, not just someone looking for another marketing job.

Apply on Indeed and include **links to Reels or TikToks you shot and edited yourself**, with one sentence on each about what you did. Applications without links won’t be considered.

Pattern is looking for a data-driven, growth-minded **Performance Marketing Manager** to manage the processes that drive qualified leads and make sure they turn into scheduled, attended meetings with our advisors.

You won't just manage campaigns or report on traffic. You'll own the physician journey from the first click to a meeting held, working across paid, organic, email, and referral channels to improve results. You'll guide our agency partner toward meaningful business outcomes, build nurture and follow-up programs that move physicians forward, and develop referral and ambassador initiatives that support long-term growth.

You'll work closely with the Sales team, our Business Intelligence Analyst, and other internal teams to understand what's working, identify opportunities, and turn marketing performance into measurable results. This role is a manager of processes not people.

**What You Will Do**

* Own lead generation strategy. Build quarterly plans with clear targets by channel and funnel stage, connecting marketing activity to qualified leads and advisor meetings.
* Manage our agency partner relationship. Help analyze performance goals, provide lead-quality feedback, and guide paid media efforts toward qualified opportunities and meetings held rather than impressions or form fills.

* Collaborate with our Business Intelligence Analyst to continually improve reporting that shows how marketing activity translates into qualified leads and meetings.
* Use CRM, marketing automation, and approved AI tools to improve follow-up, streamline repetitive work, and make marketing programs more effective.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years of marketing experience focused on lead generation and conversion into sales.
* A track record of managing marketing programs that generated measurable leads, meetings, or revenue, supported by performance data.
* Experience working with an agency or vendor partner toward clear performance goals.
* Experience managing budgets, tracking expenses, and forecasting future costs.
* Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation tools for lead nurture, reporting, and attribution.

* Experience in a regulated industry, such as insurance or financial services. Marketing to physicians or other professional audiences.

* Increased qualified physician leads generated across marketing channels who are scheduling and attending meetings with advisors.

This role requires a strategic marketer with deep expertise in the **Iterable platform** and other ESPs like Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or Bloomreach, and proven success in lifecycle marketing. **Qualifications**

* **3+ years** of hands-on lifecycle marketing experience with a proven record of driving engagement and conversion
* **2+ years** of direct, advanced experience in **Iterable**, including workflow automation, segmentation, dynamic content, and reporting
* Ability to independently produce emails using drag-and-drop tools and template-based systems
* Understanding of email marketing best practices, deliverability, and compliance
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both strategy and execution

jobs.title: Senior Technical SEO & AEO Manager
jobs.description:
The Law Offices of Spar & Bernstein, P.C. is seeking an experienced Senior Technical SEO & AEO Manager to lead our website's technical performance, organic search strategy, and visibility across traditional and AI-powered search platforms.

Our website is built on WordPress, hosted on AWS, and utilizes Cloudflare for performance and security. We are looking for a strategic, technically skilled professional who can independently audit, optimize, and improve our website.

This is a hands-on role. The ideal candidate must be able to identify technical issues, develop solutions, and personally implement improvements—not simply provide recommendations to outside developers or agencies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Technical SEO & Website Development

* Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits and independently implement fixes and improvements.

* Manage and optimize our WordPress website, including themes, plugins, templates, and site functionality.

* Troubleshoot technical issues involving WordPress, AWS hosting, Cloudflare, caching, and website performance.

* Improve Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, crawlability, and indexing.

* Resolve broken links, redirects, duplicate content, canonicalization issues, structured data errors, and technical SEO issues.

* Maintain website health and coordinate secure updates, testing, and deployments.

  

SEO, AI Search & AEO/GEO Strategy

* Develop and execute a comprehensive organic search strategy across our immigration and personal injury practice areas.
* Lead Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) initiatives to improve visibility across Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and emerging AI-powered search platforms

* Identify high-value conversational search queries and legal questions that present opportunities for AI-generated answers, citations, and traditional organic traffic.

* Develop strategies to strengthen the firm's topical authority, attorney expertise, credibility, and online presence.

  

Content Strategy & Website Optimization

* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap assessments to identify organic growth opportunities.

* Recommend new practice-area pages, landing pages, FAQs, articles, and educational resources based on search demand and business value.

* Perform comprehensive website content audits and identify pages to update, consolidate, redirect, restructure, or remove.

* Improve website navigation, URL hierarchy, internal linking, and overall content organization.

* Collaborate with the marketing and legal teams to develop authoritative, accurate, search-optimized content.
* Identify opportunities to repurpose existing video and educational content to increase organic visibility.

  

Required Qualifications

* 5–8+ years of professional SEO experience, including advanced technical SEO expertise.

* 3+ years of hands-on WordPress development experience, with demonstrated ability to independently implement technical changes.

* Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress architecture.

* Experience with AWS hosting environments and Cloudflare, including caching, performance optimization, CDN configuration, and troubleshooting.

* Advanced knowledge of crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, and technical SEO best practices.
* Experience with content strategy, keyword research, competitor analysis, and large-scale website optimization.

* Proven ability to independently manage technical projects from diagnosis through implementation, testing, and performance evaluation.

jobs.title: Technical SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

DynamiX is seeking an in-office Technical SEO Specialist to improve organic visibility, technical website performance, and AI-search readiness across a portfolio of client websites.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how websites are built, how search engines evaluate them, and how to turn technical findings into practical improvements. You will work closely with our web, content, marketing, and client teams to identify opportunities, resolve issues, and help clients become more visible in traditional and AI-driven search.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct technical SEO audits, identify issues, and prioritize clear recommendations.
* Improve site crawlability, indexing, page speed, mobile usability, internal linking, redirects, and site architecture.
* Implement and validate on-page SEO elements, including metadata, headers, image optimization, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and structured data.
* Help optimize websites and content for AI-driven search experiences, including generative search results and answer-focused discovery.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Screaming Frog, and SEO platforms to monitor performance and uncover opportunities.
* Partner with designers, developers, content creators, and project teams to ensure SEO is incorporated into website builds, redesigns, and ongoing improvements.
* Review website content and page structure for keyword alignment, user intent, clarity, and conversion opportunities.
* Create concise client-facing reports and explain recommendations in straightforward, actionable terms.
* Stay current on search-engine updates, AI-search trends, and evolving best practices.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical SEO, website optimization, or closely related digital marketing experience.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, CMS platforms, website architecture, and how these affect search performance.
* Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Screaming Frog, and SEO research or monitoring tools.
* Experience implementing or guiding schema markup and structured data.
* Familiarity with AI tools and AI-search optimization practices.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple client priorities and collaborating across teams.
* Agency or multi-client experience is a plus.

**Details**

This is a full-time, in-office role based in the Cobb County metro area/Kennesaw. Compensation will be based on experience, technical depth, and overall role fit, and will be discussed during the interview process.

**About DynamiX**

Interested in joining an amazing team of elite web professionals? DynamiX is a custom web house headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia (northwest of Atlanta). We are an *Inc 5000 Fastest Growing Company*, a *Top 25 Small Business* in Cobb County for 7 years running, and have received over 1,300 awards for our sites. We're obsessed with helping our clients win, and we love doing it! We value our team and want them to grow and thrive both personally and professionally. We do this by cultivating a sense of community and family as well as having a generous benefits package, including 401k, and great health benefits. If you are interested in working at a fast-paced, exciting and growing company, we are excited to meet and connect with you.

Our mantra is "Do it right, or don't do it". If you're eager to build great things, never settle for "just okay" and learn a lot more than you expected, then you may be just who we are looking for as we grow our team!

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Wag! Group Co. strives to be the number one platform to solve the service, product, and wellness needs of the modern U.S. pet household. Wag! pioneered on-demand dog walking in 2015 with the Wag! app, offering access to 5-star dog walking, sitting, and one-on-one training from a community of over 500,000 Pet Caregivers nationwide. Additionally, Wag! Group Co. operates Petted, one of the nation’s largest pet insurance comparison marketplaces; Dog Food Advisor, a leading pet food review platform; WoofWoofTV, reaching over 18 million followers with delightful pet content on social media; and maxbone, a digital platform for modern pet essentials, offering superfoods for dogs and stylish, functional products for today’s pet owners. For more information about our company, visit Wag.co. and wagwalking.com

  

**The Role**

Wag! is seeking a results-driven Director of SEO & SEM to lead our organic and paid search acquisition strategies. You will own search visibility, customer acquisition, and performance across Google, Bing, AI-powered search platforms, and other emerging discovery channels. The ideal candidate combines deep technical SEO expertise with hands-on paid search experience, using data, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration to drive profitable customer growth.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Search Strategy & Growth
  + Own the SEO and SEM strategy, roadmap, and execution to drive customer acquisition, bookings, and revenue.
  + Optimize performance across organic search, paid search, local SEO, and AI-driven discovery (GEO/LLMO).
  + Manage budgets, forecasting, and performance targets across paid and organic channels.
* SEO & Organic Growth
  + Lead technical, on-page, and off-page SEO, including site architecture, crawlability, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and link acquisition.
  + Develop scalable, intent-driven content and landing page strategies for dog walking, sitting, boarding, and related services.
  + Drive local SEO visibility across thousands of geographic markets and service-specific pages.
  + Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize and implement SEO improvements.
* SEM & Paid Acquisition
  + Own Google Ads and Microsoft Ads strategy, including campaign structure, keyword targeting, bidding, creative, and landing page optimization.
  + Optimize acquisition efficiency against CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
  + Lead experimentation across bidding strategies, ad copy, audience targeting, and conversion funnels.
  + Identify opportunities to improve combined organic and paid search performance.
* Analytics & Leadership
  + Establish KPIs, dashboards, and attribution frameworks to measure search-driven acquisition, bookings, and profitability.
  + Leverage GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, and SEO platforms to identify growth opportunities.
  + Manage agency partners, external vendors, and internal resources.
  + Communicate performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

  

**Minimum Paw-lifications**

* 8+ years of experience in SEO, SEM, and/or performance marketing
* Proven success scaling organic and paid search acquisition for consumer-facing digital businesses
* Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, local SEO, and evolving AI search experiences
* Advanced experience with Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO research platforms
* Strong analytical background with demonstrated ability to optimize CAC, LTV, ROAS, and conversion funnels

* Ability to work in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office

  

**Purr-furred Paw-lifications**

* Marketplace, consumer services, and/or high-growth technology experience
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Creative teams

  

**Benefits & Purrr-ks**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Complimentary parking on-site at our downtown Miami office
* Catered breakfast and lunch daily
* Monthly Wellness Stipend, and credits for both Wag! and maxbone
* Life Insurance and Short- and Long-term Disability with Guardian
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Empower and employer match as defined by plan
* 11 company-paid holidays each year
* Flexible (no set limit) discretionary paid time off in accordance with the vacation policy outlined in our handbook and subject to your manager’s approval
* Employees are eligible for paid parental leave, up to 8 weeks for non-birthing parents and 14-16 weeks for birthing parents

This position develops advertising strategy and plans over oversee its execution, including paid social and search campaigns, setting and monitoring advertising budgets, and campaign performance across search and social platforms (i.e. Meta, Google, YouTube, Amazon and LinkedIn) with the primary goal to achieve sales, leads and engagement goals, maximize return on ad spend (ROAS), and align ad operations with broader business objectives.

jobs.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring an SEO Specialist to improve client search rankings, strengthen local visibility, and help websites attract relevant organic traffic. You'll review website performance, identify technical and content issues, manage local search listings, and use campaign data to guide ongoing improvements.

This role is suited to someone with at least two years of SEO experience who can work methodically, write clear recommendations, and understand that meaningful search improvements take time. You'll be expected to monitor campaigns consistently, respond promptly when problems arise, and report results accurately without making promises the data cannot support.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Audit client websites to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, indexing problems, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop practical optimisation plans based on website audits, keyword research, and client objectives.
* Manage local business listings, check profile accuracy, and monitor customer reviews.
* Research keywords and search intent to identify opportunities for new pages and existing content improvements.
* Prepare clear content briefs outlining page objectives, target keywords, search intent, and recommended content structure.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators.
* Use Google Search Console and appropriate SEO tools to investigate changes in performance and identify potential issues.
* Review page titles, meta descriptions, internal links, headings, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Track campaign progress and prepare reports explaining performance changes, completed work, and recommended next steps.
* Investigate ranking declines, traffic changes, indexing issues, and other problems that may affect campaign performance.
* Keep campaign records, audit findings, and performance data accurate and organised.
* Respond promptly to client and team enquiries, particularly when a campaign requires investigation or corrective action.
* Communicate progress, concerns, and realistic expectations clearly to the relevant stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* **At least 2 years of professional experience in SEO.**
* Practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimisation, and local SEO.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console and relevant SEO research, auditing, and tracking tools.
* Understanding of keyword research, search intent, website indexing, and organic search performance.
* Good writing skills and the ability to prepare clear content briefs and optimisation recommendations.
* Ability to interpret ranking and traffic data and explain what the figures do—and do not—demonstrate.
* Strong attention to detail when auditing websites, checking business listings, and reviewing performance reports.
* A methodical approach to investigating technical issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks or campaigns at once.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate updates.
* Patience and consistency when managing campaigns where results develop over time.

**What to Expect in the Role**

You'll be expected to track SEO activity carefully, check your findings before reporting them, and communicate honestly about campaign performance. When rankings or traffic change unexpectedly, you should investigate the possible causes and explain what is known, what remains uncertain, and what action is recommended.

SEO requires ongoing attention rather than one-time fixes. We value consistent optimisation, realistic expectations, and prompt communication when a technical issue or campaign concern needs attention.

**Working Arrangements**

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Location:** 135 Henry St, Dayton, Ohio 45403  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Highlight your SEO experience, website auditing skills, familiarity with Google Search Console, and work with local search campaigns. Include examples of SEO projects you've supported and the performance indicators you used to evaluate progress.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

**Applicants will be considered based on job-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.**

Pay: $78,000.00 - $82,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SEO Strategist
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
You will support the lead on SEO and GEO strategy for a portfolio of agency clients, supporting delivery from first audit to reporting. This is a hands-on role for a strategist who can move between keyword research, technical fixes, AI search visibility and one that would grow into more client-facing involvement as your skillset advances. You will be the supporting strategist on retainer accounts, while being mentored by your lead strategist. Delivery and cross collaboration with PR, paid, social and creative teams is crucial, so search is considered as a part of the larger strategy in place. Clients span B2B and B2C, national and local, and regulated and consumer industries, so curiosity and adaptability matter as much as any single tool.  
  
**What you'll do**  
**On-page SEO and content strategy**

* Build content strategies that earn qualified organic traffic and turn it into leads, sales or bookings, not just clicks.
* Map keywords to the right content type and intent, and plan multiple pieces across different areas of a site so each one has a clear job in the buyer journey.
* Recommend on-page changes and page-template updates that give important pages room for richer, more useful content.
* Use internal linking, topical depth and site context to strengthen the pages that matter most.
* Plan content for national, regional or local footprints based on each client's industry and service area, including location pages and Google Business Profile optimization.
* Spot content decay and cannibalization, and decide when to refresh, consolidate or retire a page.

  
**Technical SEO**

* Support technical SEO audits and provide findings and data to be turned into a prioritized roadmap based on impact, effort and business value.
* Familiar with the value of Core Web Vitals, structured data, and clean URL and folder architecture in terms clients and developers both understand.
* Own the fundamentals with precision: title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, canonicals, redirects, XML sitemaps and robots.txt.

**GEO and AI search visibility**

* Connect GEO work to the SEO fundamentals it depends on, including crawlability for AI crawlers, structured data, and content that is easy to extract and cite.
* Analyze which sources AI platforms cite in a client's category (owned pages, earned media, reviews, forums, directories) and build strategy around that mix.
* Research the prompts and questions real buyers ask across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Claude.
* Stay current on how AI search changes and translate what's new into practical recommendations, without chasing hype.

**Measurement and reporting**

* Report organic and AI search results in business terms: pipeline, revenue, leads, bookings or enrollments, depending on the client.
* Use keyword intent and the buyer journey to explain complex targeting strategies in plain language.
* Able to present reporting outcomes to internal teams, and willing to attend client reporting sessions as a means for rapport building.

**Client leadership and delivery**

* Fully accountable to SEO retainer delivery as the direct support to client strategy leads.
* Manage workload, hours and timelines across several accounts so work stays on budget and on schedule.
* Work in partnership with other supporting strategists, fostering a team environment and interdependency with one another.
* Spot growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new-business audits.

  
**What you bring**  
**Must-haves**

* 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with at least 1 in an agency or multi-client environment.
* A track record of organic growth you can explain with real numbers and the business impact behind them.
* Working fluency in Semrush (or Ahrefs), Screaming Frog, Google Search Console and GA4.
* A clear, curious point of view on how AI is changing search.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with Profound or another GEO/AI visibility platform (Semrush AI Toolkit, Peec AI, Otterly or similar).
* Local SEO and listing management tools such as Yext, BrightLocal or Uberall.
* Familiarity with digital PR or link earning.

You don't need to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of the must-haves, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
**What you’ll get:**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Remote and hybrid working flexibility
* A wellness subsidy
* A manager who provides consistent 1:1 check-ins, feedback, and growth opportunities
* Culture-building events and cross-team collaboration
* Career advancement opportunities within a growing agency
* A strong emphasis on work-life balance

  
**What you’ll be a part of:**

* An established and still growing agency that values creativity and collaboration.
* A global team of experts who support each other and strive to achieve excellent results for clients.
* A culture that promotes diversity, work-life balance, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  
**Where will you work?**  
Anywhere in the U.S. We're a remote-first workplace with optional in-office days in Boston, Chicago, Detroit, LA, Nashville, New York, Portland, Washington DC, and more.  
  
**Anticipated Salary:** $70,000 - $85,000  
Compensation is based on experience and depending upon workplace location.  
  
**To Apply:**  
Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary in $US Dollars.  
  
While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to those with whom we have a greater interest.

Founded in 2011 on the core principles of innovation and collaborative partnership, FINN Partners has become one of the fastest growing independent public relations agencies in the world. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Sr. Marketing Data Analyst is responsible for transforming CRM, business development, and marketing data into clear, actionable insights that strengthen lead generation, support revenue growth, improve campaign performance, and guide strategic decision-making. This role serves as the business owner and primary administrator of the Company’s CRM system, with responsibility for system enhancements, reporting, dashboards, workflows, data integrity, user access, and ongoing optimization.

In addition to CRM ownership, this position analyzes data across the Company’s marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Google Analytics, digital advertising, SEO, website activity, email marketing, social media, campaign performance, and other tools used to measure customer engagement and marketing effectiveness. The role partners closely with Business Development, Marketing, IT, Corporate Training, operating subsidiaries, and leadership to turn data into actionable insights, recommendations, and measurable action to drive revenue growth.

**This role can be filled in one of the following Company offices: Houston, TX; Broomall, PA; or Tulsa, OK.**

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

* Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its Core Values.
* Represents the Company at all times with high moral standards while adhering to the Company’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.
* Serves as the primary point of contact, business owner, administrator, and internal champion for the Company’s CRM system.
* Leads CRM optimization efforts, including system enhancements, dashboards, reporting, workflows, data integrity, permissions, roles, user access, and overall system usability.
* Works closely with business stakeholders across operating subsidiaries, Business Development, Marketing, and IT to identify CRM needs, gather requirements, improve processes, and implement appropriate system solutions.
* Leads the CRM Technical Steering Team, including key end users and IT subject matter experts, to advance system functionality, adoption, governance, and long-term value.
* Critically analyzes current systems, business processes, workflows, and functional needs; recommends and implements modifications that improve efficiency, data quality, reporting, and user experience.
* Maintains CRM data integrity through duplicate detection and resolution, data cleansing, discrepancy reporting, missing or malformed data correction, and improved data governance processes.
* Integrates CRM data with other marketing and business tools to provide a more complete view of customer, prospect, campaign, and business development activity.
* Develops and maintains dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualizations that track KPIs and communicate performance trends to Business Development, Marketing, operating teams, and leadership.
* Analyzes performance across marketing channels, including CRM, HubSpot, Google Analytics, website activity, SEO, paid advertising, email marketing, social media, forms, landing pages, and campaign engagement.
* Builds and maintains measurement frameworks that evaluate campaign ROI, lead quality, funnel performance, customer journey activity, attribution, conversion rates, and marketing effectiveness.
* Develops, manages, and refines lead scoring models in HubSpot using firmographic, demographic, behavioral, web, email, and engagement data.
* Defines and monitors criteria for marketing-qualified and sales-qualified leads to help Business Development focus on higher-value prospects and opportunities.
* Cleans, organizes, and maintains HubSpot data, including properties, associations, workflows, lists, campaign data, and reporting structures.
* Collaborates with Business Development and Marketing to evaluate lead quality, campaign performance, customer engagement, and opportunities for optimization.
* Supports Business Development’s Strategic Account Management efforts.
* Conducts A/B testing, attribution analysis, ROI analysis, and campaign performance evaluation across digital channels, including email, paid media, web, SEO, and social.
* Translates complex data into actionable, executive-level insights by explaining what changed, why it matters, and what actions should be considered.
* Supports strategic initiatives by developing analysis, reporting, and recommendations that inform marketing priorities, budget decisions, campaign direction, and business development strategy.
* Partners with IT and data teams to improve data collection, system integration, security, scalability, and access to reliable marketing and CRM data.
* Works with Corporate Training and internal stakeholders to support user training, adoption, and best practices for CRM and related marketing tools.
* Supports Business Development and other functions with CRM, marketing, campaign, and financial data for reports, presentations, planning, and leadership discussions.
* Prepares monthly, quarterly, ad hoc, and executive-level reports as required.
* Identifies opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, data accessibility, self-service reporting, and overall marketing analytics maturity.
* Performs other duties or responsibilities as required or assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, CRM administration, business intelligence, data analysis, marketing operations, or a related data-driven marketing role.
* Strong working knowledge of CRM systems, including configuration of views, dashboards, reports, workflows, data structures, data integrity processes, and external reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience pulling, cleaning, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data

jobs.title: Freelance Marketing Copywriter
jobs.description:
**About Zora Digital**

Zora Digital is a digital marketing agency that blends data, creativity, and technology to help brands grow. Since 2016, we’ve helped organizations connect with their audiences, strengthen their digital presence, and turn marketing insights into measurable results.

We’re analytical and creative. Strategic but hands-on. We believe great marketing starts with understanding people, asking better questions, and using data to make smarter decisions.

As we grow our client roster and expand our work across digital marketing, technology, and AI, we’re building a network of talented independent professionals who bring fresh thinking and exceptional execution to every project.

Learn more at www.zora.digital.

**The Opportunity**

We’re looking for **experienced freelance copywriters** to join Zora Digital’s roster of independent contractors.

You’re a strong writer who knows how to make words work. You can turn a creative brief into compelling copy, adapt your voice to different brands and audiences, and balance creativity with strategic objectives. You understand that effective copy doesn’t just sound good; it moves people to think, feel, click, engage, or take action.

Our projects vary by client, industry, and scope. Depending on your expertise, assignments may include website copy, landing pages, email campaigns, social media content, SEO content, brand messaging, and digital advertising.

This is a project-based opportunity for freelancers interested in collaborating with Zora Digital as client needs arise. Joining our roster does not guarantee a minimum volume of work.

**What You’ll Do**

Depending on your expertise and the project, you may:

* Develop persuasive, audience-focused copy for websites, landing pages, email campaigns, digital ads, and other marketing channels.
* Translate marketing strategies, customer insights, and creative briefs into clear, engaging messaging.
* Adapt tone, voice, and messaging to reflect each client's brand and objectives.
* Write conversion-focused copy that supports measurable marketing goals.
* Develop SEO-informed content that serves both search intent and the reader.
* Create social media copy and content concepts tailored to individual platforms.
* Research industries, audiences, competitors, and subject matter to develop relevant, credible content.
* Collaborate with strategists, designers, developers, and other marketing professionals.
* Incorporate feedback and deliver polished work on time and within the agreed project scope.
* Use AI writing tools thoughtfully when appropriate, applying human judgment, fact-checking, and editorial rigor to the final work.

**What We’re Looking For**

**You’re an experienced professional who brings both craft and strategy to the table.**

* A strong portfolio demonstrating professional copywriting experience across relevant formats and channels.
* Excellent writing, editing, grammar, and storytelling skills.
* The ability to write in different brand voices without losing clarity or originality.
* A solid understanding of audience psychology, messaging, and marketing objectives.
* The ability to interpret a brief, ask smart questions, and work independently.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Reliable communication, sound project management, and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Comfort working remotely with a flexible, project-based team.
* A willingness to collaborate, take feedback, and refine work without losing sight of the strategic goal.

**Bonus points if you have experience in:**

* B2B, technology, SaaS, AI, consumer goods, eCommerce, automotive, or nonprofit marketing.
* Conversion rate optimization, SEO, email marketing, or performance marketing.
* Website content strategy, UX writing, or brand messaging.
* AI-assisted writing and editorial workflows.

How the Engagement Works

* **Relationship:** Independent contractor, not an employee.
* **Work arrangement:** Remote and project-based.
* **Scheduling:** Flexible, based on project requirements and agreed deadlines.
* **Compensation:** Negotiated based on project scope, deliverables, experience, and agreed rates.
* **Availability:** Assignments are offered as client projects become available. Work is not guaranteed.

Contractors are expected to manage their own schedules, communicate proactively, and deliver work that meets the agreed scope and quality standards.

**Interested in Working With Us?**

We’re always interested in connecting with talented writers who bring strategic thinking, creativity, and a strong point of view to their work.

To be considered for our freelance roster, please submit:

* Your resume or professional background.
* A portfolio with three to five relevant writing samples.
* Your areas of copywriting expertise and preferred industries.
* Your typical project rates or hourly rate.
* Your current availability and preferred types of assignments.

Tell us what you do best, what kinds of projects excite you, and why you’d be a great fit for Zora Digital.

We look forward to discovering what we can create together.

Pay: $50.00 - $100.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Detroit, MI 48201

jobs.title: Technical Marketing, Growth Manager

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

***This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.***  
*Please, no agencies/recruiters.*

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Own paid performance.** Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.
* **Drive technical SEO and conversion.** Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.
* **Build in Claude Code.** Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.
* **Measure what works.** Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.
* **Shape AI and review-site discoverability.** Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.
* **Support content and campaigns.** Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-basedoutbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, theability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more thanchecking every box.

* Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution
* Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results
* A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting
* Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization
* An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct
* A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers
* Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearl

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients
* A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup
* Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software
* Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels
* Experience with G2 or other product review platforms
* Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

* **Day 30:** Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.
* **Day 60:** Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.
* **Day 90:** Run a scaled, measurable ad program with a clear line from spend to MQLs, and a roadmap for what you will build next.

**INTERVIEW PROCESS**  
**STEP 1:** Hiring Managers  
**STEP 2**: BDR Manager  
**STEP 3**: Sales Leadership  
**STEP 4:** CRO/Executive  
**STEP 5:** Case study/Panel interview

**The Basics:**

* **Location**: Remote, US-based
* **Work Authorization:** This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Rootstock is not able to sponsor, extend, or transfer work visas for this position now or in the future — this includes but is not limited to H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, and OPT/STEM OPT extensions. Candidates who will require sponsorship at any point during their employment will not be considered.
* **Compensation:** Base salary, annual bonus, and a long-term incentive plan (LTIP).
  + Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $110,000 to $ 1200,000. Base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.
* **Benefits:**
  + Time Off: Flexible time-off, 12 paid holidays, 10 sick days, volunteer time off, and paid parental leave.
  + Recurring cell/Internet stipend

  + Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage; life, accident and disability insurance; tax-advantaged flexible spending and health savings accounts; employee assistance program; other voluntary benefit programs such as supplemental life and AD&D, legal plan, pet insurance, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity.

jobs.description:
**About Eleanor Health**

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

**About the Role**

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

**Where we are**
----------------

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

**Where we are going**
----------------------

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

* **First —** Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
* **Second —** Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
* **Third —** Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

**The channels**
----------------

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

**How the funnel is shared**
----------------------------

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

**What this role is accountable for**
-------------------------------------

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

**What You'll Do**

**Paid Media Strategy & Performance**

* Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
* Own budget pacing and allocation across all five ch

Strong written and verbal communication skills.  
Creative, self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently.
