jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As Chief Marketing Officer, you will shape how DRMP identifies opportunities, builds client relationships, and wins work. In engineering consulting, growth depends on understanding client priorities, positioning technical expertise, and bringing the right team to each pursuit. You will connect marketing, business development, market intelligence, and communications into a coordinated strategy that supports profitable growth and lasting client relationships.

This role combines strategic influence with hands-on leadership. You will partner with firm and operational leaders to decide where to compete, develop client and pursuit strategies, and coach technical professionals to communicate their value. You will also build the marketing and business development team’s capability and strengthen DRMP’s market presence. The opportunity is to shape both the growth strategy and the practices that turn it into results.

### **What you will lead:**

**Growth Strategy and Market Intelligence**

* Partner with firm leadership to translate business goals into focused market, client, and growth plans. Recommend where to invest, expand, or redirect effort based on opportunity, competitive position, and delivery capability.
* Track client capital plans, funding programs, procurement activity, legislation, and competitors to identify opportunities early and build a qualified pursuit pipeline.
* Guide go/no-go decisions with a clear view of client relationships, competitive positioning, pursuit investment, and the firm’s ability to win and deliver.
* Use pipeline, win-rate, client-growth, and pursuit data to assess results, challenge assumptions, and adjust priorities with operational leaders.

**Pursuit Strategy and Winning Work**

* Lead strategy for major pursuits, from early positioning through RFQ/RFP responses and interviews. Shape differentiated win themes around client priorities and the firm’s technical strengths.
* Provide hands-on direction on critical proposals and qualifications packages, ensuring persuasive writing, clear value propositions, and consistent quality.
* Coach technical leaders and interview teams on client engagement, presentation strategy, messaging, team selection, and rehearsal.
* Lead win/loss debriefs and apply the findings to improve pursuit selection, proposal quality, interview performance, and future results.

**Client Development and Account Growth**

* Partner with client and technical leaders to develop key-account plans, deepen relationships, and identify needs before opportunities are formally advertised.
* Equip technical professionals to build client relationships, ask effective questions, and turn insight into practical account and pursuit actions.
* Identify opportunities to bring additional services and expertise to clients. Track continuing services contracts and subsequent task orders to help account teams convert awards into sustained work.
* Gather client feedback, assess relationship health, and work with account teams to address concerns and follow through on commitments.

**Brand and Strategic Communications**

* Translate complex technical expertise and project outcomes into a clear, differentiated market position and compelling client-facing content.
* Direct thought leadership, public relations, digital marketing, social media, awards, and industry events in support of priority markets and client relationships.
* Coach leaders and subject-matter experts to communicate credibly with clients and industry audiences through presentations, articles, and speaking opportunities.
* Partner with the Chief People Officer on internal messaging and change communications, helping leaders explain business priorities while supporting the CPO’s ownership of internal communications.

**Team Leadership and Business Partnership**

* Build, lead, and develop the marketing and business development teams, with clear priorities, ownership, resource allocation, and accountability for results.
* Create trusted partnerships with operational and technical leaders. Influence across offices and disciplines, challenge constructively, and align teams around shared growth priorities.
* Strengthen team knowledge of the firm’s services, clients, and commercial priorities. Develop the team’s ability to advise pursuit and account leaders.
* Improve pursuit processes, CRM discipline, and knowledge sharing so teams can work consistently, use client intelligence, and adopt more effective ways of winning work.

  

### **What you bring:**

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 8+ years of progressive marketing, business development, or growth leadership experience in AEC, engineering consulting, environmental consulting, or a closely related technical professional services business. Comparable impact and scope will be considered.
* Experience leading a marketing or business development function, region, or business unit. Senior Directors and Vice Presidents ready for a broader remit are encouraged; a prior CMO title is not required.
* A measurable record of improving pursuit outcomes, client growth, or market position, with clear examples of personal ownership and partnership with technical leaders.
* Strong AEC pursuit expertise, including qualifications-based selection, RFQ/RFP strategy, proposal development, interview coaching, and pre-positioning. Able to connect marketing strategy with client development and winning work.
* Success leading and developing teams across offices, disciplines, or a matrixed organization, and coaching technical professionals in client engagement and business development.
* Strong commercial judgment, persuasive writing and presentation skills, and experience translating technical expertise into compelling positioning and communications.
* High emotional intelligence and credibility with senior leaders. Able to influence without direct authority, navigate resistance, and lead adoption of new processes while maintaining strong relationships

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
* **CRM & MAP Systems:** Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* **Tracking & QA:** Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
* Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

  
Pay Range: $97,700.00 - $130,300.00 Annually

jobs.description:
Location  
Fully Remote

Schedule  
Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation  
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to  
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type  
Full-time independent contractor

**About RevSpark Media**  
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

**About the Role**  
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

**Your First Focus**  
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

**What You'll Do**  
**Testing Strategy**

* Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
* Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
* Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
* Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

**Account Structure and Quality Standards**

* Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
* Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
* Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
* Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

**Strategic Direction**

* Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
* Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
* Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
* Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

**Performance Analysis**

* Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
* Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
* Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
* Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

**Client Support, As Needed**

* Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
* Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

**Why Work With Us**

* Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
* Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
* Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
* Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
* Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
* Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
* A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
* Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
* Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
* Strong written communication and documentation habits.

**Nice to have**

* Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
* Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
* Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
* Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

Scrunch, a Sitecore company, is on a mission to bring brands to an AI-first future—where people increasingly rely on LLMs to discover, understand, and act on information that matters to them.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

You will work closely with sales and marketing leadership across multiple business units to develop buyer personas, build outreach campaigns using email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement platforms, and continuously optimize performance to drive measurable pipeline growth.

* Strong writing skills: short, specific with the ability to adapt voice by persona and by subsidiary brand.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a senior Growth leader to architect and operate our growth engine from the ground up — hands‑on. This isn't a "manage the agency" role. You'll be the one designing the system, wiring the stack, running the experiments, and shipping the assets. You think in funnels and frameworks, build measurement infrastructure before you launch campaigns, and treat go-to-market as an engineering discipline: instrument, test, iterate, scale.

You'll work directly with Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand to turn signal into pipeline — and you'll be the one who actually builds the things that make that happen. Critically, you'll own the number: net new business in the form of marketing qualified leads is your north star, and you'll be accountable for hitting it. This will be a high-visibility role with incredible growth opportunities.

**What You'll Do**

**Ad Engine Ownership & Performance Marketing**

* Own the design, build, and continuous optimization of our ad engine across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and video — with a focus on efficiency, scale, and measurable pipeline contribution.
* Architect audience segmentation, bidding strategies, creative rotation logic, and budget allocation frameworks to maximize return on ad spend.
* Move beyond channel management: treat the ad engine as a product, iterating on targeting logic, landing page pairings, offer variants, and conversion pathways to compound performance over time.
* Own hands‑on execution — you're in the platforms, not just reviewing reports.

**Driving Net New Business: MQL Ownership**

* Own the MQL number. You are directly accountable for generating net new marketing qualified leads that convert into pipeline and revenue.
* Build and operate the demand generation engine that fills the top of funnel — from first touch to sales-ready hand‑off — with clear SLAs, routing logic, and feedback loops.
* Define and enforce MQL quality standards in partnership with Sales and RevOps, continuously tightening the criteria as signal improves.
* Report on MQL volume, velocity, cost-per-MQL, and downstream conversion rates; use those inputs to direct investment across channels and programs.

**Scaling the Marketing Foundation: 1 to 100**

* Take the marketing foundations already in place — brand narrative, positioning, early channel presence, initial playbooks — and build the operational engine that scales them.
* Translate strategy into a repeatable growth system: standardized processes, campaign architecture, channel playbooks, and asset libraries that multiply output without multiplying headcount.
* Identify what's working at small scale and build the infrastructure — tooling, measurement, creative, ops — to run it at 10x without losing fidelity or efficiency.
* Close the gaps between brand and demand: ensure every scaled program reinforces positioning while driving measurable business outcomes.

**Full-Funnel Growth System Ownership**

* Design and own the full‑funnel growth architecture: paid (search, social, programmatic, video), organic (SEO, content, web), ABM, partnerships, and referral.
* Build the experimentation infrastructure — test frameworks, audience segmentation, offer variants, landing page scaffolding — and run rapid learning cycles.
* Engineer the demand‑to‑pipeline path: ICP definitions, routing logic, handoff SLAs, and Sales feedback loops.
* Identify new channels and build the playbook before you scale spend.

**Growth Stack & Analytics**

* Instrument the growth funnel end‑to‑end across Salesforce, HubSpot, GA4, Webflow/CMS, and attribution/BI tooling.
* Partner with RevOps and Analytics to establish taxonomy, data hygiene standards, experimentation frameworks, and attribution models that hold up under scrutiny.
* Build dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make the "what's working" question answerable in real time — and translate results into insights, next actions, and investment guidance for Marketing and GTM leaders.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Serve as the DRI for growth: set strategy, run the operating cadence, and align Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand around clear priorities and decision criteria.
* Build influence without line authority — turn cross‑functional stakeholders into an integrated growth squad.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap and experiment backlog; communicate trade‑offs and learnings frequently.

**What You Have**

* Senior, hands‑on experience building integrated growth programs in B2B SaaS; healthtech experience a plus.
* Demonstrated ownership of an MQL or pipeline number

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

At HackerOne, great content starts with a great story. It’s how we make complex cybersecurity topics understandable, turn original research into insights people remember, and build trust with security leaders.

As our Content Marketing Manager, you’ll help find and tell those stories. You’ll lead key parts of our content program, including the HackerOne blog, annual research, search optimization, and editorial standards. You’ll work with experts across HackerOne to uncover interesting ideas, find the story in the data, and turn technical expertise into content that is clear, useful, and worth reading.

This role is part editor, part storyteller, and part content strategist. You’ll bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, and an audience-first mindset to what we create, while using data, search insights, and AI tools to help our content reach the right people and make a measurable impact.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Manage the HackerOne blog, including the editorial calendar, story development, publishing, optimization, and performance tracking.
* Lead the development of HackerOne’s annual research and flagship reports, finding the strongest stories in our data and working with internal experts and partners to turn those insights into compelling narratives.
* Find stories across HackerOne by interviewing subject matter experts, asking the right questions, and identifying perspectives that can strengthen our thought leadership.
* Turn complex cybersecurity topics into clear, engaging content for security leaders without losing the substance or expertise behind them.
* Help execute our answer engine optimization (AEO) and search engine optimization (SEO) strategy, using search data and audience insights to identify opportunities and improve content performance.
* Maintain and apply HackerOne’s Style Guide to ensure our content is clear, consistent, and distinctly HackerOne.
* Manage the content intake process, helping teams sharpen ideas, prioritize requests, and move strong stories from concept to publication.
* Multiply the impact of our best stories by adapting content for campaigns, social media, and audience engagement.
* Measure content performance and use those insights to understand what resonates with our audience and inform what we create next.
* Use AI tools throughout the content process to support research, idea development, drafting, editing, optimization, and repurposing while maintaining strong human editorial judgment.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism, or a related role.
* A strong storyteller with demonstrated experience finding an interesting angle, building a clear narrative, and making complex subjects engaging and accessible.
* Excellent writing, editing, and interviewing skills, with strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.
* Experience developing research-driven content, reports, or thought leadership and turning data and expert insights into stories for a specific audience.
* Experience managing a content program, publication, or editorial calendar.
* Experience with SEO and/or AEO, including keyword research, content optimization, and performance measurement.
* Experience using AI tools to support content creation, research, optimization, or other marketing workflows.
* Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work across teams and bring ideas from concept to publication.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience creating content for B2B technology, cybersecurity, or another technical industry.
* A background in journalism, editorial, research, or another field where interviewing and story development are core skills.
* Familiarity with content and search performance tools such as Google Analytics, SEMrush, or similar tools.
* Experience adapting stories and content for social media and other marketing channels.
* Experience partnering with product marketing, demand generation, communications, or product teams.

**ABOUT FIRST RATE**

At First Rate, we help financial institutions transform complexity into confidence through innovative WealthTech solutions, services, and data insights. Founded in 1991 and headquartered in Arlington, Texas, First Rate serves clients around the world while remaining privately held, entrepreneurially driven, and focused on building long-term relationships.

To retain profitable and referenceable clients through the delivery of cohesive team-based customer service experience and audited performance reporting data to Service Bureau clients that is defined by quality, accuracy and timeliness.

Our team stays connected through regular virtual touchpoints, shared collaboration tools, and a culture built around clear, async-friendly communication — so you have what you need to do your best work from wherever you are.

This role works across Enterprise Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Design, Customer Success, and external vendors.   + Gather campaign and event performance using engagement, lead, conversion, pipeline, cost-per-lead, return-on-investment measures and identifying performance drivers.

jobs.title: Community & Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Community & Brand Manager**
=============================

**Company:** CyberNut

**Reports to:** CEO and VP of Marketing

**Location:** Los Angeles preferred (in-office; finding someone in LA is our ideal scenario). Remote within the US considered.

**Travel:** Frequent travel across the country to customer sites, school districts, and K-12 conferences

**Type:** Full-time

**About CyberNut**
------------------

CyberNut is a fast-growing K-12 cybersecurity startup protecting more than 1 million students and staff across hundreds of school districts. Schools are one of the most targeted sectors for phishing and ransomware, and most security training was built for corporate boardrooms, not classrooms. We built CyberNut for schools.

Our platform trains teachers, staff, and students to spot phishing, scams, and account compromise as they happen, not once a year. Districts get automated, always-on phishing simulations themed to the tools schools actually use, one-click threat reporting right from the inbox, and short, gamified lessons that take minutes instead of hours. Our squirrel mascot, acorn rewards, and school leaderboards have turned security training into something staff and students actually talk about.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Gen Z or millennial content creator who lives on social media and wants to build a brand people genuinely root for. You have native experience building, publishing, and creating content on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and you know what makes people stop scrolling.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role at a fast-growing startup. You will travel around the country to meet our districts, show up at conferences, film content on site, and turn customer love into customer engagement. You will be part community builder, part brand ambassador, and the voice and face of CyberNut on social.

Why it exists: many of our districts like the brand as much as they use the platform. Leaderboards get posted, swag gets worn at conferences, and IT directors call themselves "a CyberNut school." Nobody on the team is accountable for growing that energy on purpose. This role owns it.

You will report directly to our CEO and our VP of Marketing, and work closely with Customer Success.

**What you will own**
---------------------

Your time will split roughly across three areas: brand activation (about 35%), community and engagement (about 35%), and brand, social media, and content (about 30%). The split will flex by quarter.

### **1. Brand activation in every district**

Buying CyberNut is not the same as being a CyberNut school. Activation is the work of making the brand visible, felt, and owned inside a district, and it looks different for a 2,000-student rural district than for a 40,000-student suburban one.

* Build an activation plan for every new customer during onboarding, alongside their Customer Success Manager: who the champion is, where the brand will show up (staff kickoff, hallways, the IT newsletter, the board meeting), which program launches first, and what the district will be proud of in 90 days.
* Track the activation level of every existing account (dormant, launched, visible, owned), review the lowest tier with Customer Success each month, and bring a plan to move each account up.
* Create and ship the activation kit: launch decks for staff meetings, mascot and poster assets, leaderboard displays for IT offices and staff lounges, email templates for superintendents and principals, and swag for the first winners.
* Run the launch moment. The first leaderboard reveal or the first trophy delivery should be an event, not an email.
* Tailor the plan to each district. A single champion IT director needs a different plan than a district with a cabinet-level sponsor. The goal is the same: staff say "we're a CyberNut school" without being prompted.

### **2. Community and engagement**

* Run competitive leaderboard programs across customers: district vs. district, school vs. school, department vs. department. For example, a fall "Phish Bowl" where 25 districts compete on report rate for six weeks, with sponsored prizes and a trophy that travels.
* Design and ship recurring promotions and events: Cybersecurity Awareness Month kits, end-of-year awards, a "first 90 days" challenge for new customers, and a winter swag drop for top performers.
* Build and host customer community calls to learn which gamification loops drive the most excitement and engagement: a customer call where IT directors share what worked, and an online community space.
* Partner with Customer Success on low-engagement accounts. When participation is flat, you bring the activation play (a leaderboard launch, a principal challenge, a superintendent shout-out) instead of another reminder email.
* Make engagement visible outside the district. A school that climbs the leaderboard sees itself celebrated on CyberNut's channels the same week.

### **3. Brand ambassador, social media, and content**

You own CyberNut's social channels. We want CyberNut showing up everywhere: TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn. What Duolingo did with its owl, we want you to help us do with our squirrel.

* Own the company social accounts on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a weekly content calendar you run. Marketing sets brand guidelines and campaign priorities; you create, film, and publish the day-to-day content, about 4 to 5 posts a week, most of them built from what customers are doing.
* Bring the CyberNut squirrel to life as a personality people follow, with recurring formats, trends, and moments that make the mascot recognizable well beyond our customers.
* Get on camera. Film on site at districts and conferences, try new formats, and do fun, creative things that push the brand forward.
* Own the swag program end to end: what we make, who earns it, how it ships, and the budget. Think limited editions for top performers and referrers, not giveaways for everyone.
* Show up at regio

jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About The Wells Michael Collective

The Wells Michael Collective is an independent luxury real estate brokerage in Ladue, Missouri, led by partners Justin Michael and Suzie Wells. We represent significant homes across St. Louis and present them through architecture, design and the lives lived inside them.

The role

You will be the creative voice of The Wells Michael Collective across every screen and every printed page. You will own our social presence from concept to camera to caption, build the content strategy behind it, and design the brochures, mailers and campaigns that put our homes and our people in front of the right audience.

You will sit at the table with both partners and shape how the brand looks and sounds as it grows. Your ideas will move from sketch to published within days, with no agency layers or committee approvals in between. This is an in office and in field position, split between our Ladue office and shoots, listings and events across St. Louis.

What you will own

**Social media production and publishing**

* Plan, shoot, edit and publish content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube
* Produce short form video, reels and stories for every listing, from Coming Soon through Sold
* Direct photographers and videographers on set so every shoot matches the brand
* Write captions with an editorial voice: precise, warm and free of real estate clichés
* Manage the posting calendar, community replies and direct messages

**Content strategy**

* Build and run a monthly content strategy tied to listings, market moments, advisors and the St. Louis lifestyle
* Track performance every month and turn the numbers into next month's plan
* Develop recurring series that give people a reason to follow us: home stories, architecture, neighborhoods, design
* Grow audience quality as well as audience size, with the goal of reaching the clients who buy and sell significant homes

**Brand design**

* Design listing collateral in Canva: brochures, feature sheets, postcards, mailers and presentation pieces
* Keep every asset on brand using our Canva Brand Kit, palette and typography
* Prepare print files with correct bleed and specs for our print partners
* Build InDesign layouts for longer editorial pieces as the brand expands

**Brand expansion**

* Launch new advisors with a polished public profile and content plan
* Support press, magazine ads, events and community partnerships
* Help build the visual playbook that will carry the brand into new markets

What you bring

**Required**

* 3+ years producing social content and design work for a brand, ideally in luxury, hospitality, fashion, design or real estate
* Advanced Canva skills, with a portfolio that proves it
* An eye for elevation: you know the difference between expensive and significant, and your work shows restraint
* Strong photo and video skills on a phone and in an editing app such as CapCut, Premiere Rush or Lightroom
* Clear, polished writing with a natural editorial voice
* Comfort with analytics on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn
* Organized, self directed and able to run a calendar with many moving parts
* Based in St. Louis and able to be on site at shoots, events and the Ladue office

**A plus**

* Adobe InDesign, Photoshop or Illustrator
* Experience with print production and working with print vendors
* Experience directing photographers, videographers or stylists
* A following or portfolio built around architecture, interiors or St. Louis

Please include a portfolio. We hire on the strength of the work.

Growth path

This role is designed to grow into the head of marketing as the company grows. The path is tied to results, and you will review progress with both partners every quarter.

* **Marketing & Brand Content Manager.** Own social, content strategy and listing design. Build the systems and the calendar.
* **Senior Brand Manager.** Lead campaigns, press and partnerships. Manage freelance photographers, videographers and designers.
* **Director of Marketing & Brand.** Lead a marketing team, own the brand budget and guide the brand into new markets.

You will also receive an annual professional development budget for courses, conferences and creative tools, plus direct mentorship from two partners who have built a luxury brand from the ground up.

Compensation, bonus and benefits

* **Base salary:** based on experience and portfolio
* **Annual bonus:** tied to company growth milestones you helped drive
* **Paid time off:** PTO and major holidays, with a quiet week between Christmas and New Year's
* **Professional development:** an annual budget for courses, conferences and creative tools
* **Your tools (provided by the company):** a laptop, Canva Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud and the gear you need to shoot
* **Access:** a front row seat inside some of the most significant homes in St. Louis, and direct connection to the clients, designers, architects, builders and community leaders who shape them, with real networking opportunities through our events and partnerships

How to apply

Send your resume, a portfolio link and three pieces of work you are proudest of to team@wellsmichael.com. Tell us in a few sentences what you would change first about our Instagram. We read every application, and finalists will complete a short paid creative exercise.

Pay: From $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Brand Specialist is a self-starter that keeps projects on track and on time within LifeStraw’s marketing department. This is a generalist, execution-focused role: you own the intake system, the project tracker, and contribute to building out new campaign assets and sales enablement materials. In addition to being a core contributor on the marketing team, you also serve as the primary point-of-contact to sales. You are the glue; you help the two teams stay aligned and ensure sales requests are actioned appropriately in the marketing project pipeline.

You'll report to the Senior Brand Manager and work daily with Creative, Content & Social, and the Sales team across Outdoor, Retail, Amazon, International, and Institutional channels.

**What You Own**

* **Marketing Execution**

* Develop and repurpose high-quality campaign content, including blog posts, website content, email campaigns, and social media

* Assist in running surveys to collect consumer feedback and producing an analysis of findings
* Support a regular cadence of marketing reporting to share performance data internally with key stakeholders

* Produce light graphic design in Canva, including social media graphics, email banners, event promotions, infographics, and branded collateral

* **Project Management & Request Intake (Asana)**

* Own the Asana workspace: project templates, task structure, custom fields, due dates, dashboards, and user onboarding.
* Own the shared marketing request tracker and the master marketing and sales calendar in Asana: launches, campaigns, promos, retail resets, and trade shows.
* Own the marketing request intake form and triage queue. Route every incoming request from Sales, Ecommerce, and internal stakeholders to the right owner with a due date attached and confirm receipt to the requester.

* Serve as the intake gatekeeper for ad-hoc or under-briefed requests, ensuring they follow the intake process before reaching Creative.
* Maintain and enforce SOPs for creative briefs, timelines, approval workflows, and file handoff.
* Run the weekly cross-functional sync with Sales and Marketing: agenda, notes, action items, follow-up.

* Own our Bynder DAM end to end uploads, naming conventions, metadata tagging, collections, and user permissions.
* Serve as the first responder on all asset requests from Sales, Ecommerce, retail partners, PR, and creators.
* Process new creative into the DAM once approved, correctly tagged by product, channel, and campaign, so the right file is easy to find.
* Track asset usage rights and expirations (talent, photography, licensed imagery) and flag anything approaching expiry to the Sr. Brand Manager.

You compile and maintain accurately and on time; the Sr. Brand Manager and VP set direction and interpret strategic implications.

* **Sample & seeding coordination:** Coordinate product samples and seeding shipments for press, creators, and Sales, and keep the tracking log current.

**What We're Looking For**

* A doer. You roll up your sleeves and jump in to help get marketing projects across the line.
* Organized and process-oriented. You keep a tracker updated without being asked twice.
* Reliable follow-through. You chase missing information until you get it, and you tell people when a date is going to slip before it slips.
* Detail oriented on the things that carry the brand: file names, image resolution, pricing accuracy, claim language, and version control.
* Comfortable being the connective tissue between Sales, Creative, and Marketing without needing to set anyone's strategy.
* Interest in consumer brands, sustainability, or outdoor/humanitarian markets a plus.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in marketing coordination, brand operations, or project management at a consumer brand.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
* Hands-on experience with a project management tool (Asana preferred; Monday.com, Wrike, Trello, or Smartsheet considered), including building projects and templates, not just completing assigned tasks.
* Hands-on experience with a digital asset management platform (Bynder preferred; Brandfolder, Widen, Canto, or similar considered).
* Working proficiency in Canva, including building from and managing brand t

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Type: [Full-Time]**

**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and creative Marketing Coordinator to join our team. This individual will oversee the development and execution of marketing initiatives that enhance brand visibility and drive customer engagement. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for the culinary industry. Additionally, the Marketing Coordinator will take on creative director responsibilities, guiding the overall visual and thematic direction of marketing materials and content.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Strategic Planning**

* **Market Research**: Analyze industry trends, customer preferences, and competitor strategies. Conduct surveys or focus groups to gather insights.
* **Target Audience Identification**: Define customer personas based on demographics, psychographics, and dining behaviors.
* **Marketing Goals**: Establish short-term and long-term marketing objectives (e.g., increase brand awareness, boost sales by X%, launch a new menu).

**2. Brand Management**

* **Brand Development**: Ensure brand consistency across all restaurant locations. Create brand guidelines for logos, colors, and tone of voice.
* **Reputation Management**: Monitor online reviews and social media presence. Engage with customers and address their concerns promptly.

**3. Digital Marketing**

* **Website Management**: Optimize the restaurant group’s website for user experience and SEO. Ensure menus, locations, and promotions are updated.
* **Social Media Strategy**: Develop a content calendar for platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Post engaging content, including behind-the-scenes, promotions, and user-generated content.
* **Email Marketing**: Create newsletters to inform customers about upcoming events, new dishes, and special offers. Segment the audience for personalized campaigns.

**4. Content Creation**

* **Visual and Written Content**: Produce high-quality content for various platforms, including blog posts, social media updates, videos, and promotional materials. Ensure all content aligns with brand voice and strategy.
* **Creative Development**: Lead the creative direction for marketing materials, including ad videos and detailed flyers. Collaborate with designers, videographers, and copywriters to create compelling content that resonates with the target audience.

**5. Promotional Campaigns**

* **Seasonal Promotions**: Plan and execute seasonal campaigns (e.g., holiday specials, summer menus). Collaborate with chefs to create unique offerings.
* **Loyalty Programs**: Develop a loyalty program to encourage repeat business. Use customer data to tailor rewards and promotions.
* **Events and Collaborations**: Organize events, such as tastings, cooking classes, or partnerships with local businesses (e.g., breweries, farms).

**6. Advertising**

* **Media Planning**: Identify appropriate channels for advertising (online, print, radio). Allocate budget effectively.
* **Creative Development**: Oversee the production of compelling ads that resonate with the target audience, ensuring alignment with overall marketing strategy.

**7. Analytics and Reporting**

* **Performance Metrics**: Track KPIs such as customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value, and social media engagement.
* **Regular Reporting**: Prepare monthly/quarterly reports on marketing performance. Analyze what worked and what didn’t and adjust strategies accordingly.

**8. Collaboration and Team Management**

* **Cross-Department Collaboration**: Work closely with the culinary team to ensure promotions align with menu offerings. Collaborate with operations to maintain service quality during promotional periods.

**Example Campaign Ideas**

* **“Taste of the Month”**: Feature a different dish each month, highlighting local ingredients.
* **Social Media Challenges**: Encourage customers to post their dining experiences with a specific hashtag for a chance to win a gift card.
* **Community Involvement**: Partner with local charities for fundraising events, offering a percentage of sales on specific days.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Employee discounts at restaurant locations

This individual will oversee the development and execution of marketing initiatives that enhance brand visibility and drive customer engagement. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for the culinary industry. Additionally, the Marketing Coordinator will take on creative director responsibilities, guiding the overall visual and thematic direction of marketing materials and content.

* **Marketing Goals**: Establish short-term and long-term marketing objectives (e.g., increase brand awareness, boost sales by X%, launch a new menu).

**2. Brand Management**

* **Brand Development**: Ensure brand consistency across all restaurant locations. Create brand guidelines for logos, colors, and tone of voice.
* **Reputation Management**: Monitor online reviews and social media presence. Engage with customers and address their concerns promptly.

**3. Digital Marketing**

* **Website Management**: Optimize the restaurant group’s website for user experience and SEO. Ensure menus, locations, and promotions are updated.
* **Social Media Strategy**: Develop a content calendar for platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Post engaging content, including behind-the-scenes, promotions, and user-generated content.

**5. Promotional Campaigns**

* **Seasonal Promotions**: Plan and execute seasonal campaigns (e.g., holiday specials, summer menus). Collaborate with chefs to create unique offerings.

* **Media Planning**: Identify appropriate channels for advertising (online, print, radio). Allocate budget effectively.

* Competitive salary.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.

jobs.title: Social Media & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
About InSeng Taekwondo

InSeng Taekwondo is a premier Olympic-style Taekwondo school located in downtown Boulder, Colorado. Led by world-class instructors with Olympic and USA National Team coaching experience, we offer high-quality training for beginners, recreational students, and competitive athletes.

Our mission extends beyond martial arts. We believe in developing confident, disciplined, and resilient individuals who become leaders both inside and outside the ring.

In addition to our local programs, we actively participate in and host Taekwondo competitions, seminars, and training events throughout the United States.

We're looking for a creative, motivated individual to help share our story, grow our online presence, and introduce more people to our community.

About the Role

We're seeking a part-time Social Media & Marketing Coordinator to manage our social media presence, create engaging content, and support the growth of our school.

At a minimum, we're looking for someone who can visit our studio a few times per month to capture high-quality photos and videos, create engaging Instagram and Facebook content, and maintain a consistent social media presence.

For candidates with additional experience, this role offers the opportunity to take ownership of broader marketing initiatives, including lead generation, brand development, event promotion, and membership growth.

**We're open to candidates at different experience levels**, from talented student content creators to experienced marketing professionals.

Core Responsibilities — Social Media & Content Creation

* Visit our Boulder studio approximately 2–4 times per month to capture photos and videos of classes, training sessions, athletes, and events.
* Create engaging short-form videos, including Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other video content.
* Manage content creation, scheduling, and publishing across Instagram and Facebook, with opportunities to expand to additional platforms.
* Capture compelling moments that showcase our athletes, instructors, training environment, and community.
* Edit photos and videos into polished, engaging content that reflects our brand.
* Develop creative content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule.
* Create a balance of athlete highlights, training content, community stories, and promotional material.
* Help maintain a consistent brand identity and voice across our social media channels.
* Monitor social media performance and recommend opportunities to improve engagement and reach.

Travel & Event Coverage Opportunities

InSeng Taekwondo participates in and hosts competitions, training camps, and special events throughout the United States.

Depending on interest, availability, and experience, this position may include opportunities to travel with our team to:

* Capture photography and videography at national and regional Taekwondo competitions.
* Produce behind-the-scenes content featuring athletes, coaches, and tournament experiences.
* Create event recap videos, athlete highlights, and social media coverage.
* Help promote and document tournaments, seminars, and special training events.
* Gain hands-on experience with live sports content production and event marketing.

**Travel is not required for the core position**, but opportunities may be available for candidates interested in sports media, event production, and athletics.

Approved business travel expenses will be covered by InSeng Taekwondo, with compensation and travel arrangements discussed in advance.

Additional Opportunities — Marketing & Business Growth

For candidates with stronger marketing or business development experience, responsibilities may also include:

**Lead Generation & Membership Growth**

* Develop social media campaigns to attract prospective students and families.
* Create strategies that convert social media engagement into trial class bookings and new memberships.
* Assist with responding to and following up with prospective members.
* Track inquiries, trial bookings, and marketing conversions.
* Develop and manage paid advertising campaigns through Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, and other platforms.
* Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.

**Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies for InSeng Taekwondo.
* Strengthen our brand identity and messaging across online and offline channels.
* Create promotional campaigns for programs, tournaments, training camps, and community events.
* Design or coordinate flyers, advertisements, and other promotional materials.
* Identify opportunities for local partnerships, community outreach, and cross-promotions.
* Help grow awareness of our school and its programs within Boulder and surrounding communities.
* Develop marketing initiatives that support membership growth and event participation.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Experience creating engaging social media content through professional, personal, or academic projects.
* Ability to capture quality photos and videos using a smartphone or camera.
* Familiarity with Instagram and Facebook content formats, including Reels, Stories, and feed posts.
* Experience editing short-form videos.
* Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar tools.
* Strong communication, creativity, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Availability to visit our Boulder studio several times per month.

**Preferred, but Not Required**

* Experience managing social media accounts for businesses or organizations.
* Photography, videography, or graphic design experience.
* Experience covering sporting events or producing athlete-focused content.
* Knowledge of digital marketing, paid social media advertising, or SEO.
* Experience with lead generation, customer relationship management, or marketing analytics.
* Experience developing marketing campaigns or brand strategies.
* Interest in fitness, athletics

jobs.description:
**Brand Manager**

**Farmer Group | Cortland, NY (Hybrid, 3 days/week in office) | Full-time, Exempt**

**Pay range:** $65,000 to $85,000 per year

**About Us**

Farmer Group is a fast-growing cannabis company and the home of five in-house brands: Florist Farms, Head & Heal, Blotter, Tune, and Hudson. We take pride in being a legitimate, well-run company in an industry where that's often missing, and we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

**The Role**

We're looking for an organized, collaborative Brand Manager to bring our brands to life. Reporting to the Brand Director, you'll turn brand priorities into well-run projects. You'll work closely with Sales, Creative, Product Development, and Production to deliver the materials and support our teams need.

The role combines marketing project management, brand content, retail merchandising, and vendor coordination. If you like bringing structure to a busy environment, communicate clearly, and see projects through from first brief to final delivery, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You'll DoBrand Execution & Project Management**

* Lead brand initiatives and product launches, turning business needs into clear briefs, timelines, and deliverables
* Own the shared marketing calendar for launches, promotions, events, and merchandising, and plan around creative and production lead times
* Run multiple projects across teams. Keep owners, deadlines, and priorities visible, and flag blockers early
* Partner with Sales to develop marketing materials and sales tools that support our retail accounts
* Coordinate label copy and product information between the Print Shop and Creative so labels are approved on time
* Support Product Development as new products move toward launch
* Coordinate brand materials and logistics for trade shows, retail activations, and events
* Keep tasks, approvals, and handoffs current in Asana

**Content & Brand Assets**

* Write and coordinate product copy, strain descriptions, promotional emails, catalogs, and educational materials in each brand's voice
* Route creative, product information, and claims to the right reviewers before release
* Maintain an organized library of approved brand assets and media kits

**Retail Merchandising, Swag & Vendors**

* Write briefs for packaging updates, retail merchandising, swag, and staff merchandise
* Manage vendor relationships, balancing quality, cost, and timelines
* Oversee sourcing, samples, purchase orders, and delivery with Accounting and Warehouse
* Track merchandising inventory and keep retail guidance current for the Sales team

**Budget & Process**

* Track marketing spend against plan, report regularly, and recommend priorities to the Brand Director
* Build and improve the workflows, SOPs, templates, and checklists that keep execution consistent

**What You Bring**

* 5 to 7+ years of progressive brand marketing experience in CPG or a similar consumer products industry, including at least 3 years directly managing a brand or portfolio of brands

* Clear written and verbal communication
* Proficiency with Asana or similar tools, email platforms, website and ecommerce content, spreadsheets, and digital asset libraries

*Cannabis experience is welcome but not required.*

* **Selfless Collaboration:** We work as one team and step up for one another.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Director of Sales & Marketing / Physical Therapist
jobs.description:
**Join a team that puts people first and helps you rise**
=========================================================

At Peak Performance Physical Therapy, your work matters to your patients, your team, and your future. We’re committed to helping you reach your highest potential through mentorship, collaboration, and a culture built on compassion and excellence.

#### **Who We are**

##### **A People-First Culture**

Our story began with a simple belief: when people feel supported, they thrive. As part of a family of clinics dedicated to professional growth, clinical excellence, and real human connection, we foster an environment where you’re valued, encouraged, and empowered to do meaningful work daily.

#### **Our Purpose**

##### **Empowering lives through evidence-informed care**

Our mission is to help people move freely, feel better, and live fully. Every member of our team contributes to breaking down barriers to care through prevention, education, and long-term recovery strategies. If you’re passionate about making a real difference, you’ll feel at home here.

**Director of Sales and Marketing**
===================================

**Company:** Peak Performance Physical Therapy

**Position Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Reports To:** Chief Financial Operations Officer

**Position Overview**

The Director of Sales and Marketing is responsible for driving patient acquisition, building brand awareness, and growing revenue across Peak Performance Physical Therapy's Greater Lansing locations.

This position will develop and execute sales and marketing strategies to increase patient referrals, strengthen physician and community relationships, and position Peak Performance as the premier orthopedic and manual physical therapy provider in mid-Michigan.

Approximately 60% of the role will focus on sales and marketing, with the remaining 40% spent treating patients as a physical therapist at our Lansing clinic (two days per week).

The ideal candidate combines clinical knowledge, strong relationship-building skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, and a passion for growing the business while delivering excellent patient care.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Director will be responsible for developing Peak's sales and marketing strategy and personally executing key elements of that strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Referral Development & Relationship Management**

* Develop and manage a structured outreach program to physician practices, orthopedic surgeons, sports medicine providers, and other referral sources across the Greater Lansing area.
* Build and maintain strong, lasting relationships with referring providers, their office staff, and key healthcare system contacts to drive consistent and growing patient referral volume.
* Track referral source data, identify growth opportunities, and develop action plans to expand and diversify the referral network across all clinic locations.
* Represent Peak Performance at healthcare community events, networking functions, and professional associations throughout mid-Michigan.
* Conduct regular scheduled visits to high-priority referral sources and maintain a contact management system for all referral relationships and outreach activities.

**Digital Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute Peak Performance’s digital marketing strategy, including website content, search engine optimization (SEO), Google Ads, and social media channels across all locations.
* Manage the company’s online reputation, including Google Business profiles for each clinic location, patient review platforms, and brand consistency across all digital touchpoints.
* Create and distribute content that educates prospective patients, engages referring providers, and reinforces Peak Performance’s clinical expertise and patient outcomes.
* Coordinate with external vendors, designers, or agencies as needed for creative, digital, or media production support.
* Ensure consistent brand standards, messaging, and visual identity across all locations, marketing materials, and digital channels.

**Patient Acquisition & Market Growth**

* Identify and capitalize on market opportunities to grow new patient volume across all Peak Performance locations in the Greater Lansing area.
* Develop and execute community outreach initiatives, clinic sponsorships, health fairs, employer wellness partnerships, and athletic team or league relationships.
* Collaborate with clinical directors and front desk teams at each location to optimize the patient experience from first contact through initial visit conversion.
* Track new patient sources, marketing campaign performance, and conversion metrics to evaluate ROI and continuously improve strategy.

**Marketing Operations & Reporting**

* Manage the marketing budget effectively, allocating resources to highest-impact channels and activities.
* Develop and maintain marketing calendars, campaign plans, and promotional materials for all locations.
* Provide regular performance reports to the CFOO, including new patient volume trends, referral source analysis, digital marketing metrics, and campaign results.
* Coordinate internal communications, seasonal promotions, and announcements that support clinical team engagement and patient communication.
* Evaluate marketing technology platforms, tools, and systems to improve efficiency and measurement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities of Physical Therapist**

* Evaluate patients, identify physical impairments, and develop individualized treatment plans.
* Provide evidence-based therapeutic interventions to improve strength, mobility, balance, coordination, and functional abilities.
* Educate patients and families on therapeutic exercises, home exercise programs, and injury prevention.
* Monitor patient progress, modify treatment plans as needed, and document care accurately in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies.
* Collaborate with healthcare professionals
