jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
* **CRM & MAP Systems:** Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* **Tracking & QA:** Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
* Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

  
Pay Range: $97,700.00 - $130,300.00 Annually  
This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

**\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\

jobs.title: Marketing & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Our Teacher Education Ecosystem supports educators, school leaders, and partners through professional learning and meaningful experiences.

**Come Build What’s Next**

We’re looking for a Marketing & Events Coordinator to turn event plans into seamless, well-organized experiences for educators, school leaders, partners, and colleagues.

This is an individual-contributor role focused primarily on hands-on event coordination, with additional ownership of defined marketing projects. You will help plan and execute in-person conferences, school and partner visits, webinars, information sessions, and other events from timelines and vendors to registration, materials, on-site logistics, and post-event handoffs.

You should enjoy the behind-the-scenes work of making events happen: asking the next question, spotting what is missing, keeping people informed, and solving logistical problems before they affect an event. Strong event-coordination experience matters more here than familiarity with the education industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate event execution from planning through follow-up: schedules, registration, vendors, conference booths, travel, shipping, event materials, run-of-show details, and lead handoffs
* Serve as a hands-on operational contact for assigned in-person conferences and events; coordinate with internal partners and external vendors, and provide on-site support when needed
* Support different event sizes and formats, including up to approximately three large B2B conferences annually, approximately five to seven school/partner visits, and recurring virtual events (generally one to two per month, in a supporting role)
* Build practical event playbooks, checklists, timelines, and repeatable processes; flag missing details, dependencies, and risks early
* Track event supplies, branded materials, inventory, vendor orders, expenses, invoices, and logistics so everything arrives where and when it is needed
* Coordinate assigned marketing and cross-functional projects in ClickUp or similar tools, keep ownership and deadlines visible, and support light marketing communications, editing, or quality checks as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in event coordination, marketing operations, project coordination, or a related field. Relevant internships and comparable hands-on experience are welcome
* Direct involvement coordinating actual events, such as conferences, trade shows, webinars, school events, or partner experiences not simply attending them or promoting them
* Experience managing multiple moving pieces: timelines, vendors or stakeholders, registration, supplies, schedules, and last-minute changes
* Strong written and verbal communication, dependable follow-through, attention to detail, and confidence working across teams
* Comfort using project-management tools to track tasks and deadlines, or the ability to learn new systems quickly

**Helpful, but not required:** experience in education or EdTech; familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, or Monday.com; and a bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.

**Travel Requirements:** This is a remote position requiring up to 15 - 20% domestic travel to support national conferences, partner events, and occasional office visits. Travel will vary throughout the year, with periodic visits to our Washington, D.C. office (approximately 1–2 times annually).

**Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use**

Experience with every platform below is not required. What matters most is how you organize work, coordinate people, and carry events through execution.

* ClickUp or other project-management platforms (such as Asana or Monday.com)
* Event registration, webinar, scheduling, and lead-capture tools
* Shared event calendars, checklists, run-of-show documents, and vendor trackers
* Standard collaboration, documentation, and productivity tools

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a personal assistant or an administrative catch-all for Marketing, Sales, or individual leaders
* Not primarily a social-media, creative-content, or campaign-strategy position
* Not a role focused only on planning ideas: it requires real follow-through on logistics and event execution
* Not 100% large, in-person events; the role also supports virtual events and selected marketing projects

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* See the impact of your work in well-run experiences for educators, school leaders, alumni, and partners
* Gain ownership of meaningful event operations while building repeatable processes that make the team more effective
* Partner across Marketing, Sales, Academics, and other teams, with a mix of independent coordination and shared execution
* Join a mission-driven organization where your organization, initiative, and judgment make a visible difference

**We Encourage You to Apply**

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants from corporate or nonprofit events, professional associations, school/program events, conferences, hospitality-related event operations, and similar hands-on coordination backgrounds.

However, this role does require concrete event-coordination experience, strong ownership of details, and willingness to travel. If your recent work has been focused exclusively on social media, content creation, or marketing strategy without coordinating event execution, this may not be the right opportunity.

If you enjoy turning “we should host an event” into a clear plan and a well-executed experience, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Volunteer Director of Social Media
jobs.description:
**Redeem These Ashes** is seeking a **Volunteer Director of social media.**

**About Redeem These Ashes**  
Redeem These Ashes is a 501C3 nonprofit Christian ministry that emerged from the transformative journey of former Radio Host and Pastor, Joey Krol. After years of battling with pornography, which ultimately led to his arrest for a sex crime, Krol experienced a profound transformation while incarcerated. He found redemption and healing through Christ and dedicated himself to helping others break free from the devastating effects of sexual sin. Today, as a changed man, our Founder ministers to men and their families who have been impacted by this pervasive sin.

**Vision**  
*We envision a society free from the grip of pornography.*

**Mission Statement**  
*Our mission is to educate on the dangers of pornography, advocate for its removal, and offer hope and healing through Jesus Christ, who empowers us to live a life of freedom.*

**What We Do**

* **Free Accountability App:** We are developing *In the Light*, a free app to help individuals remain accountable as they navigate freedom from pornography.
* **Education and Awareness:** Our founder shares his powerful testimony at churches and events, equipping others to find freedom in Christ.
* **Support for Fallen Pastors:** We minister to pastors and ministry leaders who have experienced moral failure, helping them rediscover hope, redemption, and a restored relationship with Christ.

**About the Role**

This is not a simple “post once a day” position. The Volunteer Director of social media provides leadership over Redeem These Ashes’ social media presence and helps shape how our message is communicated online. You will set the strategy, guide content direction, and ensure our platforms consistently reflect our mission and expand our reach. You will lead the team of two.

**The vision for our social platform is simple:** *Tactfully educating on the dangers of sexual sin, celebrate stories of redemption, restoration and hope..and pointing people to Christ.*

You will collaborate with leadership to align messaging with ministry priorities and ensure content is both effective and faithful to our mission.

Key focus areas include:

· Developing and executing a clear social media strategy across platforms

· Creating or overseeing content that educates, encourages, and equips

· Building a consistent brand voice rooted in truth and grace

· Highlighting testimonies, ministry resources, and calls to action

· Monitoring engagement and adjusting strategy based on performance

**Time Commitment**  
This is a volunteer position requiring a flexible commitment of approximately **20 hours per month**.

**Find out more about us:**

RedeemTheseAshes.org

**Instagram:** @RedeemTheseAshes

**How to Apply:** To express your interest in this volunteer opportunity, please email your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and motivation for joining Redeem These Ashes to **info@RedeemTheseAshes.org.**

Pay: $2.00 - $33.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era**
=======================================

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The **Senior Social Media Manager** owns the organic social media across our family of brands — Commerce, BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift — plus social support for select members of our leadership team.

  

This is an ownership role, not a support role. It sets the strategy, builds the calendar, makes the content, publishes it, and answers for the numbers. Partners with Creative, PR, Demand Gen, Content, and Product Marketing teams, but it shapes and owns the Social Media program.

  

The person who does well here is a strategist who is also fast with their hands. They can build a quarter-long narrative for our brands, and can also turn a keynote clip into a live post the same afternoon without waiting on anyone.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

**Strategy And Planning**

* Own a documented organic social strategy for each brand, with a clear point of view on what each channel is for and which audiences it serves (customers, prospects, partners, analysts, candidates, employees).
* Maintain a rolling four-week content calendar covering every brand and channel, extended and refreshed weekly, visible to stakeholders.
* Set and defend the content mix: executive video, customer stories, product and platform news, events, recruiting, and reactive commentary.
* Bring a quarterly plan to leadership that connects social activity to brand, demand, and communications goals.
Work alongside a new social selling agency we will deploy  

  

**Content Creation And Publishing**

* Write and edit for social: captions, threads, short-form video scripts, and executive posts that hold each brand's distinct voice.
* Produce your own assets. Use Canva, CapCut, or similar to make images and cut short-form video so that routine content ships without waiting on a design queue. You'll partner with Design on higher-craft, campaign-level work and on reusable templates for recurring post types.
* Build repeatable content series and consistent visual formats rather than one-off posts.
* Publish across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, adapting format and framing to each platform rather than cross-posting. You will have a point of view on what content should go on each channel.
* Monitor and evaluate additional or emerging channels and make recommendations about where we should activate.

**Speed On Moments that Matter**

* For events, launches, and known milestones, have content and creative prepared in advance so posts can happen in the moment.
* Cover live moments such as keynotes, events, internal all-hands, offsites, etc. yourself and capture raw video and photos to capitalize on those moments and momentum quickly.
* Monitor news, industry reports, and cultural moments for places our brands and executives can credibly add something.

**Executive And Employee Social**

* Draft, schedule, and manage social content for select senior leaders.
* Identify commentary opportunities where an executive perspective lands better than a brand post.
* Run the employee advocacy program end to end: recruit participants, supply content people actually want to share, and grow participation.

**Measurement**

* Own the numbers. Define the KPIs that matter per channel and per brand, and report monthly on what performed, what didn't, and what you're changing as a result.
* Identify top-performing posts each month and use format testing to make deliberate decisions rather than posting on habit. More volume is not the goal; engagement and impact are.
* Use Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and potentially additional tools to inform reporting.

**Brand Safety And Standards**

* Every post gets a human read for accuracy, relevance, messaging alignment, and voice before it goes out. Attention detail is a must.
Uphold brand standards across all social touchpoints, monitor for social media policy issues, and partner with PR and Community on crisis response.  

  

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in social media strategy and content creation, in-house or agency, with B2B tech experience preferred.
* You've owned a program, not just a queue. You've set the agenda somewhere rather than executing someone else's calendar.
* You are genuinely online. You understand LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube as distinct cultures, not as distribution endpoints, and you know how audiences get built.
* A strong, versatile writer who can move between brand voice and executive voice without flattening either.
* Hands-on with short-form video and design tooling such as CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, or equivalent. You can shoot on a phone and cut something good.
* Comfortable with analytics and honest about them. You can walk into a room, say a campaign underperformed, and explain what you're doing differently.
* Organized under real load. Multiple brands, multiple calendars, competing stakeholders, and you don't lose the thread.
* Proactive by default. You surface the problem and the proposed fix before someone else notice

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
**About Bizzabo**

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo. Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

Strive Online is a UK Meta-ads agency for trades and home improvement businesses. We run their Facebook and Instagram ads, build their landing pages and send them booked quotes. **The role**

You’ll run the day-to-day of the agency, so the founder can focus on sales and growth. You’ll own the team, client delivery and the systems that hold it together. This is a hands-on role: you’ll be in the systems, the client data and the team chats, not managing from a distance.

**How the role works**

* **6-month probation:** you work with us on a self-employed basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and National Insurance.
* **After probation:** you move to a permanent, employed contract with PAYE, holiday pay and a workplace pension.

**What you’ll do**

*Team*

* Manage our media buyer, client success manager, Tech VA, sales setter and video contractors.
* Run team meetings, set priorities and hold people to deadlines.
* Help hire, onboard and train new team members as we grow.

*Client delivery*

* Own client onboarding from signed deal to ads live.
* Make sure every client’s ads, landing pages, lead delivery and reporting are on track.
* Oversee complaints and escalations, and step in on difficult clients.
* Track retention and churn, spot at-risk clients early and act before they leave.

*Systems and processes*

* Own our SOPs: keep them up to date, find the gaps and write new ones.
* Improve our software and automations (GoHighLevel, Meta, Tally, Google Drive, Xero) with our developer.
* Build and run a weekly scorecard: leads, cost per lead, bookings, complaints, churn and cash collected.

*Premium offer and filming*

* Plan and run our in-person filming service: book videographers, prepare shot lists, brief clients and get footage into editing.
* Build the delivery process for our premium, higher-ticket clients.

*Commercial*

* Keep an eye on margins, contractor costs and ad account health.
* Report to the founder each week on what’s working, what isn’t and what you’re fixing.

**What we’re looking for**

*Essential*

* At least 2 years in an operations, account management or delivery lead role at a marketing or ads agency.
* Experience managing a small team, including remote or offshore staff.
* Highly organised. You build systems, document everything and nothing falls through the cracks.
* Confident with software, quick to learn new tools, and keen to improve processes.
* Calm, clear and confident with clients, including unhappy ones.
* Good with numbers: you can read a dashboard and tell what’s going wrong.

*Desirable*

* Meta ads knowledge: cost per lead, campaigns, creative testing.
* GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience.
* Use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) in your work.
* Video production or shoot coordination experience.
* Experience with trades or home improvement businesses.

**What you’ll get**

* £40,000 – £50,000 a year (invoiced monthly during probation, then as salary), plus a bonus tied to client retention and delivery targets.
* A permanent employed contract after probation, with holiday pay and a pension.
* Fully remote working.
* A real say in how the agency is run, and a direct line to the founder.
* Room to grow into Head of Operations as we scale.
* Modern tools: our own software and AI-assisted workflows.

**How to apply**

* Apply on Indeed with your CV.
* Complete our short application form (about 10 minutes). **We only review applications where the form has been filled in.**

The Director of Marketing & Growth leads marketing strategy for Independence Dental Services and its partner practices, with one clear goal: profitable new-patient growth. new_jobs.title: Community & Brand Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Community & Brand Manager**
=============================

**Company:** CyberNut

**Reports to:** CEO and VP of Marketing

**Location:** Los Angeles preferred (in-office; finding someone in LA is our ideal scenario). Remote within the US considered.

**Travel:** Frequent travel across the country to customer sites, school districts, and K-12 conferences

**Type:** Full-time

**About CyberNut**
------------------

CyberNut is a fast-growing K-12 cybersecurity startup protecting more than 1 million students and staff across hundreds of school districts. Schools are one of the most targeted sectors for phishing and ransomware, and most security training was built for corporate boardrooms, not classrooms. We built CyberNut for schools.

Our platform trains teachers, staff, and students to spot phishing, scams, and account compromise as they happen, not once a year. Districts get automated, always-on phishing simulations themed to the tools schools actually use, one-click threat reporting right from the inbox, and short, gamified lessons that take minutes instead of hours. Our squirrel mascot, acorn rewards, and school leaderboards have turned security training into something staff and students actually talk about.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Gen Z or millennial content creator who lives on social media and wants to build a brand people genuinely root for. You have native experience building, publishing, and creating content on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and you know what makes people stop scrolling.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role at a fast-growing startup. You will travel around the country to meet our districts, show up at conferences, film content on site, and turn customer love into customer engagement. You will be part community builder, part brand ambassador, and the voice and face of CyberNut on social.

Why it exists: many of our districts like the brand as much as they use the platform. Leaderboards get posted, swag gets worn at conferences, and IT directors call themselves "a CyberNut school." Nobody on the team is accountable for growing that energy on purpose. This role owns it.

You will report directly to our CEO and our VP of Marketing, and work closely with Customer Success.

**What you will own**
---------------------

Your time will split roughly across three areas: brand activation (about 35%), community and engagement (about 35%), and brand, social media, and content (about 30%). The split will flex by quarter.

### **1. Brand activation in every district**

Buying CyberNut is not the same as being a CyberNut school. Activation is the work of making the brand visible, felt, and owned inside a district, and it looks different for a 2,000-student rural district than for a 40,000-student suburban one.

* Build an activation plan for every new customer during onboarding, alongside their Customer Success Manager: who the champion is, where the brand will show up (staff kickoff, hallways, the IT newsletter, the board meeting), which program launches first, and what the district will be proud of in 90 days.
* Track the activation level of every existing account (dormant, launched, visible, owned), review the lowest tier with Customer Success each month, and bring a plan to move each account up.
* Create and ship the activation kit: launch decks for staff meetings, mascot and poster assets, leaderboard displays for IT offices and staff lounges, email templates for superintendents and principals, and swag for the first winners.
* Run the launch moment. The first leaderboard reveal or the first trophy delivery should be an event, not an email.
* Tailor the plan to each district. A single champion IT director needs a different plan than a district with a cabinet-level sponsor. The goal is the same: staff say "we're a CyberNut school" without being prompted.

### **2. Community and engagement**

* Run competitive leaderboard programs across customers: district vs. district, school vs. school, department vs. department. For example, a fall "Phish Bowl" where 25 districts compete on report rate for six weeks, with sponsored prizes and a trophy that travels.
* Design and ship recurring promotions and events: Cybersecurity Awareness Month kits, end-of-year awards, a "first 90 days" challenge for new customers, and a winter swag drop for top performers.
* Build and host customer community calls to learn which gamification loops drive the most excitement and engagement: a customer call where IT directors share what worked, and an online community space.
* Partner with Customer Success on low-engagement accounts. When participation is flat, you bring the activation play (a leaderboard launch, a principal challenge, a superintendent shout-out) instead of another reminder email.
* Make engagement visible outside the district. A school that climbs the leaderboard sees itself celebrated on CyberNut's channels the same week.

### **3. Brand ambassador, social media, and content**

You own CyberNut's social channels. We want CyberNut showing up everywhere: TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn. What Duolingo did with its owl, we want you to help us do with our squirrel.

* Own the company social accounts on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a weekly content calendar you run. Marketing sets brand guidelines and campaign priorities; you create, film, and publish the day-to-day content, about 4 to 5 posts a week, most of them built from what customers are doing.
* Bring the CyberNut squirrel to life as a personality people follow, with recurring formats, trends, and moments that make the mascot recognizable well beyond our customers.
* Get on camera. Film on site at districts and conferences, try new formats, and do fun, creative things that push the brand forward.
* Own the swag program end to end: what we make, who earns it, how it ships, and the budget. Think limited editions for top performers and referrers, not giveaways for everyone.
* Show up at regio

new_jobs.title: Paid Media Lead
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

new_jobs.description:
**About AIOS**
==============

**AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.**  
We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.  
We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.  
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

* The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.
* The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

* **Step 0 $100M/yr by end of 2025**: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.
* **Step 1 $1B ARR by end of 2026**: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.
* **Step 2 $10B ARR by end of 2028**: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.
* **Step 3 $100B/yr by end of 2031**: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.
* **Step 4 $1T/yr by end of 2035**: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.  
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

**Being a Senior Media Buyer at AIOS**
--------------------------------------

We are building a world-class team.

As Senior Media Buyer (Paid Search) at Aios, your mission is to unlock Google as a major growth channel, taking it from a small share of our paid mix today to a mature, scaled second engine that runs alongside Meta.

Google is our biggest under-tapped opportunity. Non-brand spend today is small relative to what the account can support, and our plan is to close the gap to Meta significantly across the year (>£1m/month).

Your job is to architect and drive that scale-up: growing spend profitably, without blowing out CAC, and without ever cutting corners on the strict ASA and CAP compliance rules that govern what we can say in ad copy (Rule 12.12 in particular).

Early on, you'll ramp into the accounts: current campaign structure, keyword strategy, tCPA dynamics, Search Abs Top IS, ad copy inside compliance constraints, feed setup on Shopping, and how each market behaves. As trust builds, you'll take on increasing ownership of the Google operation end-to-end.

This is not a strategy-only role. The work today is hands-on craft inside Google Ads. Over time, the ceiling is much higher: you'll lead the Google pod, take on EU markets as they launch (Germany, Netherlands, Portugal, Denmark, Sweden), and expand into adjacent channels as you earn the right.

Great performance means Google spend scales while CAC holds or improves, Search Abs Top IS climbs materially, tCPA campaigns get pushed to their real ceilings without breaking, new markets launch cleanly without hurting UK performance, compliance is never a firefight, and leadership trusts your forecasts more than their own intuition.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you'll work async in the timezone of your choice - as long as you're around for team calls (early PST).

You'll report directly to Dave Lane (Head of Performance).

You'll work most closely with:

* André Andrade - Creative Lead
* Michael McCann - Head of CRO
* Reinhardt Grobbelaar - Performance Associate

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Google Ads ownership: Over time, you operate the Google accounts day-to-day. UK is the core market and your priority today, with the rest of the EU on the cards this year. Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, Demand Gen. Keyword research, match type strategy, negatives, ad copy, extensions, feed hygiene, landing page alignment, daily optimisation.
* Profit-aware scaling: You push spend up while keeping tCPA / CAC inside target bands. You understand how to grow Search Abs Top IS through budget, bidding, and quality score. You know how to scale a tCPA campaign when actual performance is running well ahead of target without blowing out CACs.
* Compliance mastery & account resilience: You operate cleanly under ASA / CAP and GPhC rules, particularly Rule 12.12 (POMs cannot be advertised to the public). You never reference prescription medicines, named drugs, or use words like "medication" in ad copy. You maintain and evolve our MCC and account structures to keep them resilient against the unique compliance challenges of GLP-1 advertising.
* Multi-geo orchestration: You run multiple country accounts in parallel without dropping balls - different keywords, localised ad copy, different match type strategies, different compliance realities, different reporting cuts. You build the systems that make multi-geo manageable as it grows.
* Ad copy, feed and landing page craft: You write ad copy that converts inside tight character limits and strict compliance rules. You treat Bolt like an e-commerce product on Google Shopping, owning the product feed, data quality, and the ad-to-LP handoff.
* Team building: As we add more buyers alongside you and underneath you, you hire, mentor, and lead the Google pod. You build the bench that this hire is the seed of.

**Need to have**
----------------

* Proven Google scale (hands-on): You've personally operated Google Ads accounts at £1M+/month spend for DTC ecom brands, in the platform yourself every day. Not "led a team that did it." Not "oversaw an agency that did it." ***You*** did it.
* 5+ years of Google-specific depth: You know Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and Demand Gen. You can hold a credible conversation about tCPA vs tROAS vs Max Conversions, match type strategy, quality score levers, negative

new_jobs.title: Email Marketing Operations Assistant
new_jobs.description:
About Future Finance

Future Finance is building the next generation of financial media: a daily newsletter that makes markets, investing, economics, and wealth creation engaging, actionable, and easy to understand for a modern audience.

Our goal is simple: become a daily habit for ambitious professionals who want to become smarter investors and better-informed consumers of financial information.

We're not going to out-spend our way to an audience. We're going to out-think, out-create, and out-connect everyone else in this space.

The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented assistant to support the day-to-day execution of our email marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

This is primarily an execution and operations role, not a copywriting or strategy role. Your responsibility will be to ensure campaigns are loaded, checked, scheduled, and sent accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Load and schedule 7 Future Finance campaigns per week on ActiveCampaign / Iterable (free newsletter).
* Load and schedule 5 paid newsletter campaigns per week on Beehiiv.
* Assist with scheduling 1–2 daily email broadcasts for Decentralized Masters.
* Upload provided copy, subject lines, preview text, images, and links.
* Ensure campaigns are sent to the correct audience segments at the correct times.
* Thoroughly QA emails before scheduling, including formatting, links, tracking, segmentation, and send settings.
* Maintain campaign calendars and trackers.
* Flag missing information, inconsistencies, or potential mistakes before campaigns go live.
* Assist with last-minute scheduling changes when needed.
* Schedule/segment SMS broadcasts as we roll out SMS campaigns

  
**Requirements**  
  
Who You Are

Attention to detail is the #1 priority for this role. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can be trusted to execute accurately without constant supervision.

Key qualities:

* Excellent attention to detail: Catches mistakes in links, formatting, targeting, scheduling, Messaging (user experience), etc.
* Ownership and good judgment: Doesn't blindly follow instructions. Proactively flags anything that looks incorrect or unusual and asks questions when needed.
* Reliability: Consistently meets deadlines and ensures campaigns are ready on time.
* Organization: Can manage multiple brands, campaigns, and schedules without letting things slip.
* Ability to follow processes: Comfortable working with SOPs, checklists, and established workflows.
* Proactive communication: Flags blockers early rather than waiting until the last minute.
* Independent execution: Can take responsibility for recurring tasks after training.
* Tech-savvy and trainable: Comfortable learning new software and picking up tools quickly.

Experience Requirements

Prior experience with email marketing platforms is NOT required. We're happy to train the right person.

Experience with ActiveCampaign, Iterable, Beehiiv, or similar email marketing platforms is a plus, but what matters most is being detail-oriented, reliable, tech-savvy, and a fast learner.

What You Won't Be Responsible For

* Writing email copy or subject lines
* Developing email marketing strategies
* Creating offers or promotional campaigns

All copy, creative assets, and campaign instructions will be provided by the marketing team. Your role is to ensure everything is executed correctly.

Availability: Must be available and responsive between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) on working days to coordinate campaign scheduling, handle time-sensitive requests, and make any necessary adjustments.

 **Benefits**  
  
What do we offer

* Competitive salary
* Company offsites
* Remote work
* High ownership, high-impact role

new_jobs.title: Social Media Lead
new_jobs.description:
Role Overview

VERIA develops high-performance carry systems for work, commuting, travel and everyday use. We are seeking a Social Media Lead who can turn products and brand priorities into original, platform-native organic campaigns, direct the content-production vision and grow a meaningful consumer community. Own the organic social campaign process from strategy and concept to shoot direction, publishing and evaluation, while collaborating with Creative Strategy on the shared testing framework and coordinated production requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Campaign Development

* Own the organic direction for each active platform. Build campaigns for product launches, collections, seasonal opportunities and ongoing brand storytelling; translate product priorities and audience insights into distinctive social-first concepts and launch plans.

Creative Direction & Content Production

* Develop campaign creative concepts, visual references, shoot strategies, shot lists, content briefs and production calendars. Lead creative direction at planned shoots, communicate the intended storytelling to photography and video partners, and review assets for quality and brand fit.

Platform Management & Community Growth

* Own daily publishing on every active platform, including platform-native adaptation, editorial scheduling, captions, community engagement, social listening and brand consistency. Build an engaged audience rather than optimizing solely for posting volume.

Performance Analysis & Organic Optimization

* Evaluate content, campaign and channel performance through reach, quality of engagement, audience development, retention and relevant business signals. Analyze what resonates, document learnings and refine platform strategy and future campaigns.

Campaign Execution & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Lead organic launch schedules and approved production resources, coordinate the social requirements of product launches, and work with Creative Strategy and UGC & Creator Partnerships on shared briefs, testing insights, creators and overlapping production needs.

What We’re Looking For

* Proven ownership of organic social strategy and campaign delivery for a DTC, e-commerce, lifestyle, fashion or consumer-products brand.
* Portfolio of complete campaigns or product launches showing original strategic contribution, creative direction, channel execution and measurable outcomes.
* Strong visual judgment, social-first storytelling, concept development, campaign planning and the ability to turn product use cases into engaging content.
* Experience creating shoot strategies, shot lists and actionable content briefs, and directing photographers, videographers or other production partners.
* Practical expertise with platform-native organic content, publishing cadence, editorial planning and community development across relevant social channels.
* Ability to interpret organic performance and audience behavior and convert learning into better content and campaigns.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with a performance Creative Strategist and creator partnerships team while retaining ownership of organic execution.

How Success Will Be Measured

* Distinctive social-first product launch and seasonal campaigns delivered to approved schedules, with coherent storytelling across active platforms.
* Clear, executable shoot concepts, production briefs and visual direction; finished assets reflect the intended product story and brand quality.
* Consistent daily publishing, thoughtful community management and strong platform-native content quality.
* Improvement in relevant organic reach, engagement quality, audience growth and campaign effectiveness, interpreted in context rather than judged on vanity metrics alone.
* Effective coordination of photography, video, UGC and Creative Strategy inputs with minimal avoidable rework or launch delays.

Why Join VERIA?

Lead the organic voice of a growing consumer brand whose products are designed for work, commuting and travel.

Take campaigns from launch concept and shoot direction through platform-native storytelling, community engagement and measurable results, alongside dedicated production partners.

Pay: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have leading organic social media strategy for DTC, e-commerce, or consumer product brands?
* Have you independently developed and executed social media campaigns for product launches, including creative direction and content production planning?
* Have you directed professional photo or video production teams, including developing concepts, shot lists, and creative briefs?
* Can you provide a portfolio of social campaigns you personally led, including measurable organic performance results?

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Marketing & Events Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Our Teacher Education Ecosystem supports educators, school leaders, and partners through professional learning and meaningful experiences.

**Come Build What’s Next**

We’re looking for a Marketing & Events Coordinator to turn event plans into seamless, well-organized experiences for educators, school leaders, partners, and colleagues.

This is an individual-contributor role focused primarily on hands-on event coordination, with additional ownership of defined marketing projects. You will help plan and execute in-person conferences, school and partner visits, webinars, information sessions, and other events from timelines and vendors to registration, materials, on-site logistics, and post-event handoffs.

You should enjoy the behind-the-scenes work of making events happen: asking the next question, spotting what is missing, keeping people informed, and solving logistical problems before they affect an event. Strong event-coordination experience matters more here than familiarity with the education industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate event execution from planning through follow-up: schedules, registration, vendors, conference booths, travel, shipping, event materials, run-of-show details, and lead handoffs
* Serve as a hands-on operational contact for assigned in-person conferences and events; coordinate with internal partners and external vendors, and provide on-site support when needed
* Support different event sizes and formats, including up to approximately three large B2B conferences annually, approximately five to seven school/partner visits, and recurring virtual events (generally one to two per month, in a supporting role)
* Build practical event playbooks, checklists, timelines, and repeatable processes; flag missing details, dependencies, and risks early
* Track event supplies, branded materials, inventory, vendor orders, expenses, invoices, and logistics so everything arrives where and when it is needed
* Coordinate assigned marketing and cross-functional projects in ClickUp or similar tools, keep ownership and deadlines visible, and support light marketing communications, editing, or quality checks as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in event coordination, marketing operations, project coordination, or a related field. Relevant internships and comparable hands-on experience are welcome
* Direct involvement coordinating actual events, such as conferences, trade shows, webinars, school events, or partner experiences not simply attending them or promoting them
* Experience managing multiple moving pieces: timelines, vendors or stakeholders, registration, supplies, schedules, and last-minute changes
* Strong written and verbal communication, dependable follow-through, attention to detail, and confidence working across teams
* Comfort using project-management tools to track tasks and deadlines, or the ability to learn new systems quickly

**Helpful, but not required:** experience in education or EdTech; familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, or Monday.com; and a bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.

**Travel Requirements:** This is a remote position requiring up to 15 - 20% domestic travel to support national conferences, partner events, and occasional office visits. Travel will vary throughout the year, with periodic visits to our Washington, D.C. office (approximately 1–2 times annually).

**Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use**

Experience with every platform below is not required. What matters most is how you organize work, coordinate people, and carry events through execution.

* ClickUp or other project-management platforms (such as Asana or Monday.com)
* Event registration, webinar, scheduling, and lead-capture tools
* Shared event calendars, checklists, run-of-show documents, and vendor trackers
* Standard collaboration, documentation, and productivity tools

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a personal assistant or an administrative catch-all for Marketing, Sales, or individual leaders
* Not primarily a social-media, creative-content, or campaign-strategy position
* Not a role focused only on planning ideas: it requires real follow-through on logistics and event execution
* Not 100% large, in-person events; the role also supports virtual events and selected marketing projects

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* See the impact of your work in well-run experiences for educators, school leaders, alumni, and partners
* Gain ownership of meaningful event operations while building repeatable processes that make the team more effective
* Partner across Marketing, Sales, Academics, and other teams, with a mix of independent coordination and shared execution
* Join a mission-driven organization where your organization, initiative, and judgment make a visible difference

**We Encourage You to Apply**

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants from corporate or nonprofit events, professional associations, school/program events, conferences, hospitality-related event operations, and similar hands-on coordination backgrounds.

However, this role does require concrete event-coordination experience, strong ownership of details, and willingness to travel. If your recent work has been focused exclusively on social media, content creation, or marketing strategy without coordinating event execution, this may not be the right opportunity.

If you enjoy turning “we should host an event” into a clear plan and a well-executed experience, we would love to hear from you.

**What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process**

new_jobs.description:
**About Bizzabo**

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo. Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

  
Requirements:  
  

**What you'll do**

* Own positioning and messaging for the Event Experience OS. Translate new agentic capabilities into clear, provable value for enterprise event leaders, and keep the story consistent from the website to the last call before signature.
* Run launches end to end. Partner with Product on what we build and why, then own the go-to-market: narrative, pricing and packaging input, launch plan, field readiness, and customer communication.
* Help us win competitive deals. Own competitive intelligence against legacy event management platforms and newer point solutions. Build battlecards, landmine questions, and objection handling that reps actually use, and run win/loss analysis to sharpen them.
* Equip the field. Build the pitch narrative, demo storylines, one-pagers, and RFP content. Partner with Sales and Solutions leadership to train the team and make sure every new capability is sold, not just shipped.
* Lead analyst relations day to day. Own our Forrester and Gartner relationships, evaluation submissions, and briefings, plus our presence on peer review sites like G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.
* Turn customers into proof. Work with Account Management to build case studies, reference programs, and the metrics that make our claims specific.
* Drive adoption. Partner with Account Management to get existing customers using what we ship, through release communications, programs, and content for executive business reviews.
* Own the context layer. Our messaging, product, and competitive knowledge powers the Claude Skills our teams use to write, sell, and support. You'll keep that source of truth current and use AI to automate your own GTM workflows.

**﻿What success looks like**

In your first 90 days:

* You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.
* You've refreshed our core competitive materials and the field is using them in live deals.
* You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.
* You've shipped your first launch end to end.

In your first year:

* Our competitive win rate is measurably higher, and you can show which of your work moved it.
* Every major release goes to market with a clear story, trained reps, and customer adoption plans.
* Our analyst and peer review position reflects where the product actually is.
* The messaging that powers our people and our AI agents is sharp, current, and trusted across the company.

**﻿What you need**

* 5+ years of product marketing in B2B SaaS selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including time as the lead or sole product marketer.
* An AI-native way of working. You've used AI agents, ideally Claude, to automate real GTM workflows, and you can show us what you built.
* A track record of positioning complex platforms for both business and technical buyers, and of winning against an entrenched incumbent.
* Strong sales enablement instincts. You build narratives and assets that get used in the field, and you know how to check that they do.
* Hands-on experience with analyst relations, ideally including a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.
* Excellent writing. You make complicated things simple without making them generic.
* Comfort building without a big team around you: you set your own priorities, move fast, and ship.

**﻿Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in your day-to-day work.
* Experience in event technology, martech, or another platform sold to marketing teams.
* Experience marketing agentic or AI-first products to enterprise buyers.
* Experience with a three-sided value story (in our case, organizers, attendees, and sponsors).
* Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, and comfort pulling your own data from them.

*In accordance with the New York Pay Transparency Law, the annual salar
